title: Senior UX Designer (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.


**We are looking for a Senior UX Designer with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working across Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



Space Engineers is a complex sandbox game built around engineering, construction, exploration, survival, and player creativity. That complexity is part of what makes the game unique \- but it also creates significant UX challenges.



We are looking for someone who can take real ownership of how players interact with our systems, identify usability problems, and turn complex mechanics and information into clear and intuitive player experiences.



Because we are a relatively small team, we are looking for a hands\-on and versatile UX Designer who can contribute beyond UX theory, wireframes, and documentation. Strong UX expertise is the foundation of the role, but ideally you also bring visual/UI design skills or, alternatively, experience with technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation. Visual/UI design is particularly valuable for us given the current composition of the team.



You will work closely with Game Design, Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, helping shape both existing and new features from early concepts through to implementation.



We expect you to act as a proactive UX partner \- identify friction, challenge existing solutions when needed, test assumptions, and help us establish stronger UX principles across both games.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hours).**



If you enjoy challenging work, autonomy, impact, and responsibility, come and join us

  


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **5\+ years of professional experience as a UX Designer, Game UX Designer, or similar role, with significant experience working in the video game industry on PC and/or console games**
* Proven experience designing UX for shipped video games, ideally across multiple features or systems
* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions
* Hands\-on approach to UX design, **with experience in at least one adjacent discipline that allows you to contribute beyond UX documentation – ideally UI/visual design, or alternatively technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation**
* Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, usability principles, navigation systems, and information hierarchy
* Experience working on sandbox, simulation, strategy, management, or other systems\-heavy games
* Strong experience designing UX for complex and interconnected game systems, such as inventories, building systems, crafting, progression, control schemes, or similar mechanics
* Ability to make complex mechanics and information understandable and intuitive without removing their depth
* Strong wireframing and prototyping skills using Figma or equivalent tools
* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX
* Strong design judgment – able to identify usability problems and their root causes, propose practical solutions, and explain design decisions using player needs, evidence, and clear reasoning
* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions
* Proactive and self\-driven, with the ability to work independently, iterate quickly, receive feedback, and adapt solutions when needed
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


**Nice to have**
----------------


* Strong visual/UI design skills, including typography, layout, iconography, visual hierarchy, and the ability to take UX concepts through to polished, production\-ready interface designs
* Experience creating or adapting UI assets and working within an established visual language or art direction
* Experience implementing or integrating UI directly in a game engine or proprietary engine
* Experience combining UX design with UI/visual design and/or technical implementation within the same role
* Experience working on live games and improving established systems without disrupting existing player workflows or expectations
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements
* Work with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA from the early stages of feature development to shape solutions that balance player needs, game design intent, visual clarity, technical feasibility, and production constraints
* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences


**Define and improve:**


* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.

title: Product Manager, Procure-to-Pay
description:
Zone \& Company Software Consulting LLC ("Zone") is the ERP\-native AI platform for financial operations, purpose\-built for organizations running on Oracle NetSuite. We are redefining how finance teams operate by delivering an AI\-powered system that automates, connects, and scales financial workflows directly within the ERP.



As the AI operating system for finance teams in NetSuite, Zone enables more than 4,500 customers worldwide to run smarter, faster, and with greater accuracy. Our platform spans the full financial lifecycle, including Quote\-to\-Cash, Procure\-to\-Pay, Treasury, Payroll Management, and Record\-to\-Report, eliminating manual processes and unlocking real\-time financial intelligence.



By embedding intelligence directly into NetSuite, Zone helps finance teams move beyond reactive work to proactive, strategic impact. Learn more at www.zoneandco.com or follow us on LinkedIn: linkedin.com/company/zoneandco.

### **About the Job**



The Product Manager owns strategy, roadmap, and execution for the Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) domain of the Zone \& Co platform — covering procurement, vendor management, AP automation, invoice capture, approvals, and payments. Reporting to the Director of Product, this role spans the full product lifecycle, from discovery through launch and ongoing health of live features.



You'll translate complex AP/procurement workflows (requisition\-to\-approval, three\-way match, invoice capture, payment execution) into intuitive software built natively on Oracle NetSuite. This is a ground\-floor opportunity in "Agentic Finance" — you'll spend more time in working prototypes than slide decks, using AI to move from insight to demo in hours, and you'll define how autonomous agents earn user trust in a domain where accuracy is non\-negotiable.


### **What You'll Do**


* Define product vision and strategy for P2P, backed by market and customer research
* Own the roadmap — set OKRs and prioritize new features, enhancements, defects, and tech debt
* Lead development with Engineering and Design through the Agile lifecycle
* Drive Agentic AI integration — automate invoice coding, matching, exception handling, and approval routing, while designing guardrails, confidence thresholds, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints
* Prototype fast with AI, then turn what works into requirements, user stories, and quality evals for AI features
* Partner with Sales and Marketing on GTM strategy and enablement
* Ensure product logic meets global financial and tax compliance standards
* Monitor performance and iterate based on data and customer feedback
* Protect UX so complex workflows stay intuitive within NetSuite
* Manage backlog, stakeholder alignment, UAT, and internal training
* Use AI tools to summarize customer feedback from Support and Sales
* Evaluate third\-party integrations and support technical debt reduction

### **What You'll Need**


**Required**


* AI\-native: builds with AI daily and has shipped AI/agentic features to production
* 5\+ years in Product Management within Fintech, ERP, or B2B SaaS, with direct P2P/AP/procurement ownership
* Hands\-on finance experience (practitioner or close partner to AP/procurement/controllership teams)
* Track record taking roadmaps from discovery to launch
* Experience owning a live, at\-scale product — balancing new work against defects, escalations, and tech debt
* Strong Agile/Scrum skills and familiarity with tools like Jira or Productboard
* Proven success in fully remote, async, globally distributed teams
* Excellent communicator, able to translate compliance logic into simple software


**Preferred**


* Experience with Oracle NetSuite or a comparable native ERP platform
* Familiarity with P2P/spend tools (Coupa, Ariba, Bill.com, Tipalti, AvidXchange, Ramp) and OCR/document capture
* Understanding of multi\-jurisdictional tax logic (VAT/GST/Sales Tax)
* Finance/accounting/procurement certification (CPA, ACCA, CIMA, CPIM, etc.)
* Experience scaling products in high\-growth (Series C–D) environments

**Benefits**



At Zone, we provide the platform; you provide the grit. We operate as a high\-velocity, fully remote, global team where autonomy isn't just a perk, it's the standard. We're looking for self\-driven professionals eager to navigate the complexities of a unique SaaS environment and take full command of their professional evolution.



We ditch micro\-management for high\-trust flexibility, ensuring you have the space to innovate and scale. Our benefits are built to fuel this lifestyle, supporting your life beyond the screen so you can focus on making a global impact. Explore our offerings at https://www.zoneandco.com/careers


**Join Our Global Mission**



Zone \& Co is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. We thrive on unique perspectives and strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Here, your identity is valued, and your talent is the only limit to your growth. All qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, religion, sex, orientation, age, disability, or any other protected factor.


**Employment Terms**


**United States**



Employment with Zone is **"At\-Will"**, meaning either party may terminate the relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law. This job description does not constitute an employment contract or guarantee of continued employment. Duties and responsibilities may evolve as the company grows and may change at any time with or without notice.


**Non\-US Jurisdictions**



This position is offered as a Fixed\-Term or Permanent Contract based on your country of residence. Employment is subject to a written contract which outlines specific notice periods, probationary terms, and statutory entitlements.

title: Senior Director, Technical Services
description:
#### **About Parsec**



Parsec Automation, LLC (Parsec) is a trailblazing creator and provider of manufacturing operations management software. Consistently recognized by organizations like Gartner and IDC and a winner of numerous awards, including the Data Breakthrough Awards, American Business, and Best in Biz, Parsec exemplifies leadership in the dynamic, fast\-paced manufacturing sector. With major companies such as Johnson \& Johnson, Merck, Toyota, Proctor \& Gamble, Eli Lilly, Hershey, Siemens, and DuPont leveraging its innovative TrakSYS™ platform to tackle even the most complex manufacturing challenges, Parsec's solutions are actively optimizing efficiency, quality, and compliance at over 11,000 plants in more than 140 countries. Committed to customer success and driven by innovation, Parsec continues to fulfill its mission of making the management of manufacturing operations as simple as possible.



Parsec is backed by BVP Forge, a $780M fund in partnership with the $20B Bessemer platform that has backed industry\-defining businesses such as LinkedIn, MindBody, Procore, Shopify, and Toast. BVP Forge combines Bessemer's front\-line industry insights, proven growth IP, and robust executive network with tailored resources for self\-sustaining companies and the ForgeEdge™ operational program.

  


**The Role**



Parsec is hiring a **Senior Director, Technical Services** to unify and scale the technical backbone of its Professional Services organization. This role owns three distinct but interdependent workstreams: Advisory, Delivery, and Support. Each currently operates with its own rhythm, skill set, and client touchpoints. The mandate for this role is to bring these workstreams together under one operating model so that clients, SI partners, and internal teams experience a consistent standard of technical excellence, regardless of which workstream is engaged.



This is a build\-and\-run role. The teams exist today; the person in this seat will professionalize how they operate, scale them as the business grows, and ensure new hires ramp to full productivity on a defined timeline. Success is measured by predictable delivery, fewer escalations, improved resource utilization across workstreams, and a technical organization that partners with Enablement, Sales, and SI/GSI partners as a single, credible voice on TrakSYS.

  


**Role Characteristics**


* **Organizational Span:** Owns three workstreams: Advisory, Delivery, and Support, all spanning approximately 30–40 FTEs based primarily in the US and Spain, with additional coverage across Europe.
* **Delivery Accountability:** Accountable for delivery outcomes across all three workstreams, including quality, timeliness, and client/partner satisfaction.
* **Governance \& Control:** Establishes shared standards, handoff protocols, and reporting cadence across workstreams (capacity planning, utilization, backlog health, escalation tracking).
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership**: Serves as the primary point of contact for workstream health, capacity, and delivery status communications to PS leadership.
* **Collaboration:** Works closely with Project Managers (who retain ownership of individual engagements), Enablement, Sales, and SI/GSI partners.
* **Scaling:** Builds hiring plans, role profiles, interview standards, and leveling criteria to support growth across all three workstreams.

  


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Advisory Workstream**


* Own the quality bar for design artifacts produced by Solution Architects and Tech Leads, ensuring consistency across SI partner\-led and Parsec\-led engagements.
* Deploy Advisory resources across concurrent engagements, balancing SI support requests against direct delivery needs.
* Build and maintain design standards, reference architectures, and reusable artifacts that reduce rework across engagements.
* Serve as the escalation point for design decisions that carry architectural or precedent\-setting weight.

  


* **Delivery Workstream**


* Manage the engineering resource pool as a shared capacity model: intake, prioritization, staffing, and rebalancing across concurrent projects.
* Partner with assigned Project Managers on scope, timelines, and quality gates without owning the PM function.
* Set and enforce engineering and QA standards across POC, enhancement, and targeted delivery work.
* Track velocity and throughput to inform capacity planning and hiring timing.

  


* **Support Workstream**


* Own support SLAs, coverage models, and on\-call structures across a 24/7, multi\-region team.
* Ensure upgrade assessments, upgrades, and technical reviews follow a consistent methodology and artifact set.
* Develop a repeatable mentoring and knowledge\-transfer offering for clients and SI partners.
* Feed recurring support themes and technical debt patterns back into Advisory and Engineering to address root causes.

  


* **Cross\-Workstream Responsibilities**


* Establish shared standards and communication norms so clients and SI partners receive a consistent experience across Advisory, Delivery, and Support.
* Build the metrics, reporting cadence, and operating rhythm that make delivery predictable and visible to leadership (dashboard support provided by the Operations team).
* Partner with Enablement to define ramp paths and curricula for new hires and ongoing development paths for tenured staff.
* Report on workstream health, capacity, and delivery metrics to PS leadership, and translate technical delivery performance into terms an executive audience can act on.

  


* **Success Measures**


* Advisory, Delivery, and Support operate against shared standards and a shared reporting model.
* New hires reach full productivity on a defined, predictable timeline, in partnership with Enablement.
* Delivery predictability improves, reflected in fewer escalations, tighter SLA adherence, and more accurate capacity forecasting.
* Clients and partners experience a consistent technical governance model across all three workstreams.
* Leadership has real\-time visibility into workstream health, capacity, and risk.

  


**Qualifications**


* **Experience:** 10\+ years in technical delivery, professional services, or engineering leadership within enterprise software, industrial software, or MES/manufacturing operations platforms.
* **Multi\-Function Leadership**: Demonstrated experience managing multiple technical functions concurrently (e.g., solution architecture/advisory, engineering delivery, and technical support) as a unified organization.
* **Distributed Teams:** Experience managing distributed, international teams; direct experience with US/Europe (Spain in particular) team structures is a strong plus.
* **Scaling:** Track record of building or scaling a technical delivery function during a growth phase, including hiring plans and ramp/enablement design.
* **Operational Skills**: Strong operational instincts in capacity planning, utilization management, SLA and escalation frameworks, and delivery metrics.
* **Range:** Comfortable operating at both the strategic level (org design, executive reporting) and the technical level (credible in design and architecture conversations).
* **Partner Ecosystem:** Experience working with or alongside System Integrator (SI) and Global SI (GSI) partner ecosystems.
* **Platform Experience:** Direct experience with MES, MOM, or industrial automation platforms (TrakSYS or comparable platforms) preferred.

  


**Benefits**


* $200,000–$255,000 base, plus bonus eligibility
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k) with company match
* Generous paid time off and company holidays
* Professional development and career growth opportunities
* Collaborative and innovative work environment
* Opportunity to make a meaningful impact at a growing global software company

  


**Location**



This is a fully remote position.

title: Senior Direct-Response Video Editor, DTC Performance Ads
description:
**About Us**


HarZa is a fast\-growing operator of direct\-to\-consumer brands in health and wellness. Our flagship brand, Rejuvacare, serves over 400,000 customers who trust us with their health, and we are now launching and scaling new portfolio brands. The company has scaled 12x in a single year to over 150 people across 15\+ countries. We are remote\-first, async\-first, and hold a high standard of accountability across everything we do. Paid media is our growth engine, and creative volume is what makes it scale.

**The Role**


You will be the editing engine of a performance pod: a small team built around a creative strategist, a media buyer, and a copywriter, shipping direct\-response ads for claims\-led health and wellness brands. This is not a brand content role and not an organic social role. Every asset you cut exists to convert on paid traffic, and your work is measured by how it performs, not only by how it looks.


The creative challenge is specific: our products solve problems (chronic pain, mobility, wellbeing) whose results are not visually obvious. Your edits build belief through mechanism explanation, testimonials, UGC structures, advertorials, and VSL\-style long form, always with awareness that we operate in a compliance\-sensitive category. You will produce both short\-form ads (15 to 60 seconds) and long\-form direct\-response formats (2 to 6 minutes), and a large part of your week is iterating winners: new hooks, new openings, cutdowns, and format variations of ads that are already scaling.


This is a high\-volume seat and we say so openly. The target output is at least one long\-form ad of around 5 minutes plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos per working day, which comes to roughly 15 to 20 delivered assets per week including iterations. If that rhythm sounds extreme, this is not the right role. If it sounds like the environment you already work in, we should talk.

**What You Will Own**


Direct\-response editing at volume. Editing short\-form and long\-form paid ads from strategist scripts and briefs, shipping platform\-native formats for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, and sustaining the daily delivery target of one long\-form plus 2 to 3 short\-form videos without sacrificing the craft details that drive performance: hooks, pacing, captions, sound design, and pattern interrupts.


Winner iteration and creative testing. Producing hook variations, cutdowns, re\-orders, and format swaps of winning ads as a first\-class deliverable. Feeding the testing loop the pod runs every week and turning performance feedback into the next round of edits quickly.


Claims\-led storytelling. Building belief for outcomes the viewer cannot see: visualizing mechanisms, structuring testimonial and UGC narratives, editing advertorial and VSL long form that holds attention for minutes, and handling claims with compliance awareness.


Pod collaboration and documentation. Working async\-first inside the pod with your strategist and media buyer, keeping Asana as the single source of truth for briefs, versions, and delivery status, and turning feedback into revised cuts without friction or ego.

 **Requirements**  

Proven experience editing paid direct\-response ads for DTC or ecommerce brands, where your videos ran on real media budgets and you saw the numbers. Fluency in both short\-form ad formats and long\-form DR (VSLs, advertorials, 2\+ minute belief\-building videos). A demonstrated high\-volume rhythm: you have sustained daily ad output in a testing environment, not one polished piece per week. Working knowledge of the metrics that judge your work (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA or ROAS) and a track record of letting data change your edits. Experience in health, wellness, supplements, or other claims\-sensitive verticals is a strong plus. Full professional proficiency with a modern editing stack, reliable remote setup, and the self\-management to thrive in an async\-first, output\-measured company.

 **Benefits**  

A fully remote position at a high\-growth DTC operator launching new brands. Real ownership inside a performance pod where your work directly drives scale. Paid time off, wellness stipend, company\-funded computer allowance after tenure milestone, monthly bonus structure, birthday gift card, and in\-country meetup allowance. A culture that rewards output, speed, and mastery of craft.

title: Senior Social Media Strategist
description:
**TheSoul Group** is a leading creator business platform positioned at the heart of the creator economy. Our original videos, animations, and editorial stories inspire audiences in **21 languages**, across **60 platforms** and **20 websites**.  

Together with our network of **talented creators**, we reach over **5 billion followers** and generate more than **100 billion monthly views** on social media.


As a global powerhouse in digital media, we drive viral success for creators and brands worldwide through a wide range of services, leveraging our expertise in content distribution, localization, and social media management. We’re the creators behind global phenomena such as **5\-Minute Crafts** and **BrightSide**.


We’re a dynamic, remote\-first global team, fostering award\-winning creativity, a no\-red\-tape approach, and great vibes!


We are looking for a **Senior Social Media Strategist** to own the social and audience strategy behind the YouTube channel of a globally recognized beauty brand.


In this role, you will define the strategic direction for a high\-growth, high\-volume global YouTube channel with a Shorts\-first approach. You will identify the audience behaviors that drive discovery, subscription, and purchase, translate cultural and trend signals into repeatable content direction, and shape the content calendar around key product launches, activations, and brand moments.


You will own the growth strategy behind what the channel publishes, developing clear hypotheses, reviewing performance alongside analytics specialists, and adapting the approach based on what the data shows. You will also shape the creator activation strategy, from briefing and selection criteria to performance evaluation and progression across creator tiers, while identifying how organic content can connect effectively with commerce and paid amplification.


Working closely with creative, analytics, community, and account teams, you will ensure that social strategy translates into clear, actionable direction across the wider project. You will also present and defend strategic recommendations to senior client stakeholders across media and marketing.


A strong understanding of YouTube, internet culture, creators, and emerging subcultures is essential, together with a proven track record of growing social channels rather than focusing primarily on campaign\-led activations. Experience working with large brands in beauty or closely related consumer categories is strongly preferred.

 **Requirements**  

* Proven track record of growing social media channels or accounts, with the ability to demonstrate measurable growth and clearly explain the strategies and decisions that drove it.
* Strong agency\-side experience in social media strategy for large brands, with experience in beauty or a closely adjacent consumer category strongly preferred.
* Deep understanding of YouTube formats, audience behavior, discovery, and creator culture, alongside strong knowledge of other major social platforms.
* Demonstrable ability to assess content strategically and structurally, identifying why specific content performs and translating those insights into repeatable approaches.
* Strong understanding of internet culture, emerging trends, online communities, creators, and subcultures.
* Experience developing content and audience strategies for high\-volume publishing environments is highly desirable.
* Experience designing and running creator or influencer activations, ideally across multiple markets, is an advantage.
* Strong analytical fluency, with the ability to interpret performance data, challenge assumptions, identify inconsistencies, and develop testable hypotheses.
* Ability to adapt strategic direction based on performance data and confidently scale, refine, or discontinue approaches based on evidence.
* Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills, with the confidence to present and defend strategic recommendations to senior client audiences.
* Understanding of social commerce or affiliate mechanics is a plus.
* Familiarity with paid social planning and the relationship between organic performance and paid amplification is a plus, but not essential.
* Native\-level or professional working proficiency in English.

  

**Benefits**  

* **Flexible Engagement Structure:** This opportunity is offered under an independent service\-provider agreement, giving you the freedom to shape how you deliver your expertise. You define your own working methods, organise your schedule independently, and contribute your skills to clearly scoped projects. Compensation is agreed individually and reflects your experience, capabilities, and the value you bring to each engagement.
* **Location Freedom:** You can deliver services from any suitable location that supports high\-quality outcomes, whether that’s your home office, a co\-working space, or wherever you feel most productive and inspired. What matters most is the impact you create and the reliability of your delivery.
* **Global Network and Inspiring Projects:** You’ll collaborate with a diverse international network of professionals across 85\+ countries, contributing to projects that reach vast audiences and help shape the future of digital content. This is an opportunity to work alongside talented specialists, exchange ideas, and be part of meaningful initiatives with real global reach.
* **Smooth Collaboration and Project Support:** To enable efficient service delivery, we provide modern collaboration platforms, clear project coordination, and streamlined processes. This helps you focus your energy where it matters most, producing high\-impact work and bringing creative solutions to life.
* **Make a Global Impact:** Your expertise will contribute to initiatives that influence audiences worldwide. Join projects that push creative boundaries and help build the next generation of digital experiences.

title: Senior GTM Engineer
description:
Join the GTM Revolution at SalesCaptain — Where B2B Growth Happens
Since our beginnings in 2021, SalesCaptain has grown into a global force, working with fast\-growing B2B brands, YC \& Techstars startups, and Series B/C companies, helping them go to market through predictable, scalable outbound systems.


We're looking for a **Senior GTM Engineer** to own and evolve our outbound revenue infrastructure across client accounts.


This is a hands\-on senior role sitting at the intersection of **data, automation, AI, deliverability, intent signals, and outbound strategy**. Beyond building systems yourself, you’ll help set technical standards, introduce new GTM technologies, and mentor other team members.


This is a full\-time, remote role, working EU hours.


About the role
You’ll work closely with GTM Strategists, Campaign Managers, and other GTM Engineers to architect scalable outbound systems from ICP definition through campaign execution and reporting.


You’ll own complex Clay workflows, data infrastructure, intent and signal\-based targeting, automation, and deliverability, while continuously testing new AI and GTM tools that can improve our results.


We’re looking for someone who can not only build great systems, but also **lead technically, challenge existing processes, and help raise the standard of the wider team.**


What you’ll do ✨* **Architect end\-to\-end outbound systems**, from ICP and TAM definition through enrichment, sequencing, CRM sync, and performance reporting
* Build and optimize **advanced Clay workflows**, including enrichment waterfalls, Claygent, AI columns, conditional logic, and custom API integrations
* Own and improve **email deliverability infrastructure**, including domains, inbox health, sending infrastructure, authentication, reputation, and scaling best practices
* Design **intent and signal\-based outbound systems** using signals such as job changes, funding, hiring activity, website intent, technology adoption, social activity, and other buying signals
* Build automation workflows with **n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs, and webhooks**
* Use AI and LLMs to improve prospect research, qualification, personalization, data processing, and campaign workflows
* Continuously explore and test **new AI and GTM technologies**, identifying tools and approaches that can give SalesCaptain and our clients an advantage
* Write lightweight Python or JavaScript and work directly with APIs when no\-code tools aren’t enough
* Partner with GTM Strategists to improve targeting, campaign architecture, and outbound performance
* Establish best practices and documentation for GTM engineering workflows
* **Mentor junior and mid\-level GTM Engineers**, review workflows, troubleshoot complex problems, and help the team develop technically
* Proactively identify inefficient processes and design better, more scalable solutions

  

**Requirements**  

  

Who you are ❤️‍
You should have:

* 3\+ years of experience in GTM Engineering, RevOps, outbound operations, growth engineering, or a closely related role
* Strong hands\-on experience building outbound systems in a B2B SaaS, GTM agency, consultancy, or fast\-moving technology environment
* Advanced experience with **Clay**, including complex enrichment workflows, Claygent, AI columns, waterfalls, and APIs
* Strong understanding of **email deliverability**, sending infrastructure, domain reputation, authentication, and inbox health
* Experience designing campaigns around **intent data and buying signals**, rather than relying only on static prospect lists
* Strong knowledge of the modern GTM tooling ecosystem and genuine curiosity around emerging AI and automation tools
* Comfort working with APIs, webhooks, JSON, automation platforms, and basic Python or JavaScript
* A strong commercial mindset — you understand ICPs, messaging, outbound performance, pipeline, and why targeting decisions matter
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to design systems rather than simply execute predefined tasks
* Experience mentoring, supporting, or reviewing the work of other team members
* Excellent English communication skills (C1–C2\), with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders
* Experience working with Tech, SaaS, or B2B software companies


We’re also open to candidates coming from **RevOps, growth engineering, Clay consulting, outbound operations, or highly technical SDR/BDR backgrounds** who have transitioned into systems building.


What good looks like
You are successful in this role if:

* GTM Strategists trust the systems and data you build without needing to recheck everything
* Our outbound infrastructure remains scalable, reliable, and deliverability\-safe
* Intent signals help us identify better prospects and improve campaign timing
* Clay and automation workflows are clean, efficient, documented, and cost\-effective
* You regularly introduce new AI, automation, and GTM approaches that improve how the team works
* You identify problems before they become bottlenecks
* Other GTM Engineers improve through your mentoring and technical guidance
* You help the team move faster while maintaining a high standard of data and execution quality


This role is not for you if* You have never used Clay or similar GTM automation tools
* Your outbound experience is limited to basic LinkedIn scraping or list building
* You have little understanding of email deliverability
* You prefer executing instructions rather than designing systems and proposing improvements
* You are not interested in experimenting with new AI and GTM technologies
* You are uncomfortable taking ownership of complex technical problems
* You do not enjoy mentoring or sharing knowledge with other team members

  

**Benefits**  

In addition to joining a fast\-growing GTM team, we offer:

* Remote work
* Collaborative, friendly, and ambitious team
* Paid vacation, days off, and sick leave
* Team\-building activities
* Free books and Kindles to support your development
* Specialized training and access to leading GTM tools
* Opportunity to work with international B2B brands, startups, and scaleups
* Hands\-on exposure to emerging AI, automation, data, and GTM technologies
* Significant autonomy to experiment, introduce new tools, and influence how our GTM infrastructure evolves
* Opportunity to mentor others and play a key role in developing the GTM Engineering function

title: Senior Marketing Artist (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.  

  

**We are looking for a Senior Marketing Artist with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working on Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



We are looking for a strong visual artist who can take real ownership of how Space Engineers is presented across marketing channels. You will turn in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets, and ideas into high\-quality promotional visuals, while also actively helping define what our marketing materials should look like, how they should be structured, and where the visual quality can be pushed further.



You will work across a wide range of marketing and promotional materials \- from key visuals, store assets and campaign graphics to screenshots, banners, logos, splash screens, social media content, and other 2D artwork.



This is not a purely execution\-focused role. We are looking for someone who can identify opportunities independently, challenge existing approaches when needed, propose stronger visual solutions, and help establish and evolve a consistent marketing art direction for Space Engineers.



You should combine a strong artistic eye with speed, versatility, and practical execution \- someone who can explore multiple directions quickly, make sound visual decisions, work with feedback, understand the purpose behind each asset, and consistently deliver polished results.



We expect you to act as a proactive visual partner to the team, not simply wait for briefs \- spotting what is missing, proposing what should be created, and helping raise the overall standard of our marketing presentation.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hour)**



If you enjoy challenging work, seek autonomy, thrive on impact and responsibility, and want to work in a friendly environment with an inspiring international team, then come and join us!


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **6\+ years of professional experience as a Marketing Artist, 2D Artist, or Graphic Designer in the video game industry, specifically working on PC and/or console games.**
* Basic knowledge of or hands\-on experience with motion graphics and animation tools such as Adobe After Effects or similar software.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating high\-quality video game marketing and promotional artwork
* Experience creating and defining brand identities from the ground up, as well as evolving established visual identities across multiple marketing channels and asset types.
* Proven experience creating assets such as:
* + key visuals and campaign artwork
	+ promotional and store screenshots
	+ banners and social media assets
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ promotional compositions based on in\-game or 3D content
* Strong skills in Adobe Photoshop
* Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator
* Excellent understanding of composition, typography, color, lighting and visual hierarchy


**Experience creating assets for Steam, PlayStation, Xbox and other gaming platforms**


* Experience working with 3D assets or game engines to prepare promotional compositions and screenshots
* Knowledge of Blender, Unreal Engine, Unity or similar 3D tools
* Strong photo manipulation, image editing and post\-processing skills
* Ability to take existing in\-game content and transform it into compelling promotional visuals
* Ability to adapt to an established visual identity while also proposing new creative directions
* Ability to receive feedback, make changes quickly and iterate efficiently
* Strong attention to detail combined with the ability to balance quality and delivery speed
* Proactive, self\-driven mindset and ability to work independently
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


### **Nice to have**


* Experience with motion graphics or video editing
* Familiarity with Figma
* UI/UX or in\-game UI experience
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation or technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Executive Producer
* Help define, maintain, and evolve the visual brand identity of Space Engineers across marketing materials, platforms, and campaigns.
* Create high\-quality marketing and promotional artwork for Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2
* Develop compelling visual concepts based on in\-game content, screenshots, 3D assets and existing game art
* Create a wide range of graphical materials, including:
* + key visuals
	+ promotional screenshots and beauty shots
	+ store and platform assets
	+ banners
	+ social media graphics
	+ splash screens
	+ logos and branding elements
	+ campaign visuals
	+ event and presentation materials
	+ other 2D promotional artwork
* Capture, compose and post\-process in\-game imagery to achieve strong promotional quality
* Adapt key visuals into multiple formats, resolutions and platform requirements while maintaining consistency and quality
* Collaborate with artists, marketing, production and other disciplines to understand the purpose and audience of each asset
* Explore multiple visual directions quickly before committing to final polish
* Maintain consistency with the established artistic direction and identity of Space Engineers
* Take technical and production constraints into account when proposing concepts and solutions
* Incorporate feedback efficiently and bring assets to a high\-quality final state
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, templates and production efficiency, particularly for recurring marketing assets

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Strong visual judgment** – understand what makes an image compelling, readable and effective
* **Speed, clarity and ownership** – we expect results, not status updates
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, take feedback well and be willing to discard an idea when a better one emerges
* **Purpose\-driven design** – understand what an asset needs to communicate rather than simply making it look attractive
* **Versatility** – comfortably switch between different types of marketing and 2D tasks
* **Direct communication and execution** – no politics, no hiding behind blockers, no red tape

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions


**Time off \& wellbeing**


* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs
  


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

description:
### **Mission – Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you**



SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM\-connected, high\-quality experiences across in\-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement product that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn events into a company's most effective engagement channel.



This role sets and runs the security configuration of the company across different tools we use.



This position is the ideal role for **someone who wants to raise the level of IT security in an environment where it carries real weight**. Our customers are enterprises, and more than half a million healthcare professionals engage on Onomi every month. How our own accounts, laptops and tools are secured is part of that picture rather than a back\-office concern. This is not about one access request or one control, it is about lifting the IT layer that everything else sits on.



As a Security Operations Engineer, you will be reporting to the Chief Security and Trust Officer and you will spend roughly:


* 35% Identity, access and lifecycle. Joiners, movers and leavers, access requests and approvals, associate access, security hygiene across our SaaS tools, access reviews. Google Workspace is our identity layer.
* 20% Endpoint management and protection. Implementing both across our macOS fleet, then keeping the fleet in a known state and triaging what the tooling reports once it is live.
* 30% Security controls and access models inside our tools. Around a dozen SaaS applications, each with its own permission model, its own security controls, its own limits on what can actually be enforced, and its own logging capability. You will manage how each should be configured, design the role and permission structures inside them, work out what a given plan tier does and does not allow, and know where a tool is blind so we can compensate elsewhere. This also covers the alerts and logs from the tools we already have, including threat intelligence.
* 15% Building internal tooling. Access reporting, cross\-tool investigation, and a small, deliberately tuned detection layer. Built primarily with Claude Code, jointly with the CSTO, against a written specification that already exists.


This is an IT security role covering identity, device management and internal telemetry, with a real build component. It sits in security rather than IT because the work is judged on risk rather than on service.



The role is both preventive and reactive. Most of it is preventive: closing gaps before anyone else finds them, and building the visibility that shows you where they are. But when a security event happens, you are part of the response, and security events do not keep office hours. This is not a shift pattern or a formal on\-call rotation, and it is not frequent.


### **Objectives \- The problems you will solve**



In your first 1 month:


* You have a complete inventory of our tools and of how access to each one is granted and removed.
* You know which accounts exist across those tools and which of them map to a real person.
* You run onboarding, offboarding and access requests independently, without escalation.
* You have given us your first read on the environment: the three or four things you would fix first, why each one matters, and what it would take.


After 3 months:


* You have a view of the *security* settings in each cloud/SaaS tool we use, what each is capable of enforcing, and what it currently enforces.
* You have recommended the changes worth making in priority order, and the first of them are already applied.
* You have produced the plan and the recommendation for the new endpoint management and protection: the options, the obstacles we will hit, and how you would get past them.


After 6 months:


* New endpoint management and protection are running across the fleet and you can report coverage.
* There is one place that shows who has access to what across all tools, and access reviews run from it and produce the evidence export.
* The new Security Dashboard is built to the point where a real investigation can be done in it.

### **What you need to be great at:**


* Working across multiple areas of security rather than specialising in one, in combination with "standard IT activities". Identity, endpoints, tool configuration and logging all sit in this role, and none of them get a dedicated person.
* Judging the balance between security that limits people and what the business actually needs to get done. Knowing which control is worth the friction and which one will simply be worked around.
* Because of our business, users often need immediate action. Some tickets can wait a week and some arrive as a Slack message because a customer event is happening now. Judging which is which, without treating everything as urgent or making people escalate to get attention, is a daily call.
* Google Workspace as an identity platform, including SSO and SAML app integration, groups and org units, admin roles and delegation, context\-aware access, the security and admin audit logs and the alerts built on them
* Understanding the usage of APIs, minimally knowledge around REST and HTTP methods status codes, authentication via API keys, OAuth 2\.0

### **What we are most curious about:**


* How you decide between buying and building, what you base it on, and how the decision survives in real life.
* Where you think the effort really belongs when it comes to security settings and capabilities, and which attack vectors matter most for a company like ours.
* Your process for choosing security tools, what you rule out early, and what you insist on testing before anything gets signed.
* How you adapt your views and actions based on publicly known security incidents and breaches.
* How you handle the human pressure to override security requirements.
* A detection or an alert you switched off, and what convinced you.

title: Occupancy Planner
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

We are looking for an Occupancy Planner, to join our Occupancy Planning and Management team.
  
  

About JLL \-
  
  

We’re JLL \- a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We shape the future of real estate for a better world by using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities. As a Fortune 500 company, we help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. We have operations in over 80 countries and a global workforce of over 92,000 individuals. We believe a diverse and inclusive culture is one where everyone succeeds. That’s why we’re committed to creating an environment where we all feel welcomed, valued, and empowered to achieve our full potential.
  
  

Confidence can sometimes hold us back from applying for a job. But we’ll let you in on a secret: there’s no such thing as a “perfect” candidate. JLL is a place where everyone can grow no matter how they identify or what background they bring with them. If you’re a leader of any level or experience and this job description resonates with you, let’s talk.
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

As Occupancy Planner, you will be responsible for tracking, analysing, and updating space data and using this information to develop scenario and occupancy plans for our client's portfolio in a designated region.
  
Fostering relationships
  
You’ll foster critical relationships between various individuals and organizations. Simultaneously, ensuring coordination and collaboration among various business units, especially facility management, will be crucial as you aim to get accurate growth projections. Planning strategies that drive construction projects and support their implementation will demand your constant attention, and so will regular facility audits.
  
  

Day\-to\-day deliverables would include monthly reporting, periodic data audits, tracking and managing utilization data and trends, as well as gathering space and adjacency requirements, updating space layouts, developing space planning and block diagrams.
  
  

Managing spaces
  
Planning and managing portfolios, as well as maximizing space, will be your major focus areas while you assist clients in their migration plans, group, and individual moves. This will involve using various forms qualitive and quantitative data to understand supply and demand.
  
  

Reporting
  
Major requirements for you will be to get familiar with space utilization methods and the presentation of utilization data. You’ll work closely with clients to reconcile discrepancies from top\-down projections, as well as track and report actual seat demand at the group level.
  
  

**Sounds like you? To apply, you need to be:**  

Tech\-savvy
  
You have critical thinking skill sets and can easily tell a story through data. You will be successful on the job if you have skills in Microsoft Excel (pivot table, vlook\-up, cell calculations), and understand floorplans. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to consolidate data and floor plans into PowerPoint Presentations for clients will be highly valuable for the job.
  
  

A communication champion
  
Excellent communication skills are important – both written and spoken. An individual with strong interpersonal skills, able to understand complex ideas and communicate them to others, and an ability to interact with executive\-level external and internal clients will be successful in the role. You’ll be effective in your role by learning to ask the right questions to understand the underlying needs of our clients.
  
  

Dynamic
  
Thinking strategically, simplifying the complex, seeing the big picture, and driving results are few of the basic requirements of the job. Moreover, you should thrive on change with an appetite for risks and be proactive and innovative with solutions. We would love your intellectual curiosity towards digital drive, hunger for learning, and urge to meet deadlines.
  
  

**Below are the skills and experience that we are looking for:**  

Literacy in reading and interpreting floor plans
  
A working knowledge of occupancy utilization, office design principles and trends such as the mobile or collaborative workplace
  
Attentive to detail and accuracy \- particularly numbers and spatial creativity
  
Work experience in occupancy or space planning for corporate clients; or interior office planning, furniture planning/management, move/project management, or related Facilities function in a corporate real estate setting
  
A Bachelor’s Degree is preferred
  
  

**What you can expect from us:**  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment.
  
  

Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, recognizing your contributions, investing in your well\-being, and providing competitive benefits and pay.
  
  

We can’t wait to see where your ambitions take you at JLL.
  
  

Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Machine Learning Operations Architect (with medical device experience)
description:
#### **Your mission**

  

We are scientists, doctors, techies and humanity lovers, with the mission of pioneering real time precision neurology to cure brain\-related disorders. INBRAIN harnesses the extraordinary material properties of Graphene, the world’s thinnest and nobel\-prize winning material, to build high resolution neural systems. *Our mission is to decode and modulate neural networks to restore people's lives.*  

  

As a **Machine Learning Operations Architect**, you will architect and own the model lifecycle governance and deployment infrastructure. The role bridges **MLOps engineering with medical\-device design\-control practice**: it defines how models are versioned, validated, and promoted, and builds the change\-control framework (aligned with a PCCP\-style approach) that governs how adaptive, continuously\-learning models can be safely updated post\-deployment.  

  

You will be at the forefront of bringing advanced healthcare solutions to market, making a tangible difference in people´s lives worldwide.

#### **Your profile**

 **Main Responsibilities:**

  

* Design and build the model versioning, lineage, and validation\-evidence system that ties every trained model to its training data, the data source origin, risk management, and clinical evidence.
* Draft and maintain a Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP)\-style framework defining permitted modification types, bounds, and automated re\-validation protocols for adaptive models, in collaboration with clinical, regulatory, product and software stakeholders.
* Design and configure the CI/CD pipeline for training, validating, and promoting models, running on infrastructure provided by the Software team, with promotion gates across Development, Testing, Acceptance and Production (DTAP) tiers.
* Build drift and performance monitoring for models and define triggers for scheduled vs. drift\-triggered retraining as part of post\-market surveillance activity.
* Deployed and maintained processes and services versioning and tracing them against design\-control processes.

  

**Mandatory Qualifications and Soft skills:**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
* At least **4\-5 years of Hands\-on** **ML Ops** **engineering experience (preferably in medtech industry)**: model versioning/registries (MLFlowor equivalent), CI/CD for ML, containerized deployment (Kubernetes), and workflow orchestration (e.g.Argo or equivalent).
* **Strong Architecture experience within industry setting (only academia or traineeship will not be considered).**
* Proven experience shipping ML into a regulated or safety\-critical environment (medtech \- priority, automotive, aerospace), has designed systems to automatize design\-control processes (e.g.IEC 62304, ISO 13485, DO\-178C, ISO 26262\) and has used them from the inside.
* Strong infrastructure\-as\-code skills and comfort directly supporting data scientists to productionize research code written in Python.
* **Fluency in English** required (English is company language).
* Direct experience with continuous/adaptive learning systems under a change\-control or PCCP\-like framework, delivering personalized evolving models in contrast to single model validation for universal use releases.
* Comfortable operating at the intersection of engineering and regulatory/clinical teams, translating design\-control requirements into concrete technical implementation.
* Pragmatic about scope and sequencing — able to prioritize the governance/compliance work.
* Strong written documentation skills, given the role's heavy emphasis on producing auditable change\-control and validation records.

  

**Nice to have:**  

* Experience with FDA's Predetermined Change Control Plan (PCCP) guidance or equivalent adaptive\-SaMD regulatory frameworks (e.g.through an imaging/diagnostic AI company that has filed one).
* Background in adaptive neurostimulation, closed\-loop deep brain stimulation or closed\-loop diabetes management with insulin pumps.
* Familiarity with clinical data standards (FHIR, SNOMED CT, NWB/BIDS) and ISO 14155/MDR/ICH E9 evidence frameworks.

#### **Why us?**

  

We are looking for someone who Is ready to proactively bring new ideas to the team, push boundaries, and constantly look for innovation. At INBRAIN we believe in shared success and diverse ways of thinking, here you'll learn, grow, and advance in an innovative culture  

  

**WHAT CAN WE OFFER TO YOU?**

  

* A collaborative environment where innovative ideas flourish and teamwork drives us forward. At INBRAIN, we believe the power of collective intelligence is unique. You will be part of a team that thrives on open communication, knowledge sharing and mutual respect.
* Meaningful Work Impact: Our projects are not only exciting and challenging but also have a positive impact on the industry and society as a whole. You'll be part of a team that strives to create meaningful change.
* Cutting\-Edge Technology Exposure: Joining us means immersing yourself in the latest technologies and innovative solutions. You'll have access to state\-of\-the\-art tools and resources, fostering continuous learning and keeping your skills relevant in a rapidly evolving industry.
* Competitive salary (according to your experience/skills)
* Internal flexible compensation scheme
* Private Health Insurance
* Training bonus for professional development and access to Udemy platform
* 23 vacation days per year
* Christmas week off
* Hybrid working modality

  

***Applications must be submitted in En******glish***  

  

At INBRAIN, we're not just offering a job – we're inviting you to be part of a transformative journey, Are you ready to transform lives? Join us!  

  

***\#diverseandinclusive***  

We believe that a diverse and well\-balanced workforce drives innovation. At INBRAIN, we foster the inclusion of all people regardless of culture, age, gender, sexual orientation, identity and diverse abilities or any other status.#### **About us**

**At Inbrain Neuroelectronics, we built our company around a simple belief: great science needs great people.**

Contract type Full time
Job ID R\-259736
  
**Why choose AstraZeneca Spain?**
---------------------------------


AstraZeneca Spain is a rising force in our global business. With headquarters in Madrid and our global hub in Barcelona, we’ve become an important international centre of excellence in the fight against critical disease. Boasting vibrant universities and business schools, the Barcelona ecosystem is a place where scientists can thrive.
