title: Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Employer:** **DWS Group**

**Title:** **Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director**

**Location:** **Madrid**

**Job Code:** *placeholder for LinkedIn job wrapping*

**About DWS:**

Today, markets face a whole new set of pressures – but also a whole lot of opportunity too. Opportunity to innovate differently. Opportunity to invest responsibly. And opportunity to make change.


Join us at DWS, and you can be part of an industry\-leading firm with a global presence. You can lead ambitious opportunities and shape the future of investing. You can support our clients, local communities, and the environment.


We’re looking for creative thinkers and innovators to join us as the world continues to transform. As whole markets change, one thing remains clear; our people always work together to capture the opportunities of tomorrow.


As investors on behalf of our clients, it is our role to find investment solutions. Ensuring the best possible foundation for our clients’ financial future. And in return, we’ll give you the support and platform to develop new skills, make an impact and work alongside some of the industry’s greatest thought leaders. This is your chance to achieve your goals and lead an extraordinary career.


This is your chance to invest in your future.


Read more about DWS and who we are here.


**Team / division overview**

The role sits at the intersection of hands\-on delivery and strategic influence. You will work directly with engineers, analysts, delivery leads, and business stakeholders to identify meaningful AI use cases, build practical examples, coach teams, and remove blockers to adoption. At the same time, you will translate what is being learned on the ground into clear recommendations for leadership, tooling, governance, roadmap choices, and ways of working.


Reporting into the Head of Corporate Functions (CF) Technology, you will be embedded in the area where AI adoption needs to happen. You will also work closely with the DWS AI Centre of Excellence, ensuring that Corporate Functions is both aligned to enterprise AI direction and actively shaping it through real delivery experience. You will help create and nurture the Corporate Functions AI Community of Practice, so that knowledge, experimentation, and adoption are shared across teams rather than remaining isolated in individual pockets.


**Your responsibilities –**

As Corporate Functions AI Strategy and Adoption Lead, Director, you will:


* Act as the primary AI champion embedded within the delivery and operational teams, working alongside engineers, analysts, and delivery leads to embed AI into everyday practice.
* Lead and facilitate the AI Open House and equivalent adoption programmes including curating peer wins, facilitating skill\-building segments, and visibly resolving blockers.
* Coach individuals and teams on practical AI use, from prompt engineering and gen\-AI features through to building RAG pipelines and agentic workflows.
* Serve as the primary convenor and energiser of the AI Community of Practice ensuring it has rhythm, relevance, and genuine peer ownership.
* Curate and grow a shared knowledge base of AI use cases, prompt libraries, lessons learned, and emerging tools relevant to the team.
* Design and run lightweight experimentation programmes including challenges, hackathons, discovery sprints that surface new AI applications and build confidence across teams.
* Act as the CF technology team’s primary AI thought leader and strategic advisor to leadership translating field\-level insight into strategic recommendations.
* Stay current with AI developments across the industry particularly in financial services and bring relevant intelligence into AI CoE leadership conversations and roadmap decisions.
* Advise CF business stakeholders on how AI can be applied to their specific domains, translating technical capability into business value language.
* Build, test, and iterate on AI\-powered tools, prototypes, and integrations demonstrating feasibility and sparking wider adoption through working examples.
* Design and implement end\-to\-end AI solutions including RAG pipelines, LLM\-powered applications, and agentic workflows that connect AI to real business processes.
* Evaluate internal and SaaS AI models, platforms, and tooling including LLMs, agentic frameworks, and productivity tools and make grounded recommendations based on practical, production\-aware experience.

We are looking for


* Demonstrable hands\-on experience building software, with confidence working in a modern development environment and credibility with engineering teams.
* Practical, working experience with AI models and tools including LLMs, prompt engineering, AI\-assisted coding tools such as GitHub CoPilot or equivalent. Demonstrable delivery of at least one RAG implementation, an agentic workflow, a fine\-tuned model, or a production LLM integration.
* A genuine track record of driving AI adoption within an organization, making it happen at the team level and measuring what changed.
* Experience working in or closely with technology teams in complex organizations — ideally within financial services, professional services, or similarly regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to work across multiple organizational layers from coaching junior developers to briefing senior leadership
* Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
* Proficiency in Python (strongly preferred) and comfort working in a modern development environment
* Working knowledge of LLM APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent and experience building applications on top of them beyond simple prompting.
* Hands\-on experience with AI development tooling: vector databases, embedding models, orchestration frameworks, and evaluation and observability approaches.
* Understanding of agentic AI patterns, including tool use, planning, multi\-agent coordination with experience designing or building systems that use them.
* Understanding of how regulated financial services organizations operate including data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and the specific risk appetite that shapes technology decisions.
* Awareness of how leading financial institutions are approaching AI adoption.
* Ability to translate AI capability into business value language relevant to financial services such as risk reduction, control improvement, cost efficiency, revenue enablement, client experience and making the case to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrably well\-read on AI developments. You follow research, read technical blogs, track model releases, and can hold a credible conversation about where the field is heading and what it means for the organisation.
* Strong understanding of change management and adoption dynamics. You know why people resist new tools and how to meet them where they are and led early interest into sustained adoption.
* Curious about the intersection of AI and organisational design \-how capability builds, how communities form, and what it takes to move an institution rather than just a team.

**What we’ll offer you:**

At DWS we’re serious about diversity, equity and creating an inclusive culture where colleagues can be themselves and it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work \- feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks, or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.


DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in\-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.


If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long\-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let them know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview, or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.


We at DWS are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, one that embraces dialogue and diverse views, and treats everyone fairly to drive a high\-performance culture. The value we create for our clients and investors is based on our ability to bring together various perspectives from all over the world and from different backgrounds. It is our experience that teams perform better and deliver improved outcomes when they are able to incorporate a wide range of perspectives. We call this \#ConnectingTheDots.

title: Associate Director, Real Estate Investment Banking
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Associate / Associate Director SCS
  
  

The Role
  
  

We are seeking an Associate/Associate Director to join our EMEA Strategic Capital Solutions team based in London, Madrid or Frankfurt. The team combines our Real Estate Investment Banking and Pan European Capital Markets Sector teams as an integrated, market\-leading platform.
  
We specialise in complex, multi\-stakeholder transactions including large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, recapitalisations, joint ventures, new funds and structured equity transactions. The team operates from offices in London, Madrid, and Frankfurt, within a highly motivated, high\-performing, investment\-banking\-style environment that values initiative, analytical rigor, and ambition.
  
As Associate/Associate Director, you'll be a trusted member of the team supporting directors throughout the full life cycle of projects. You will play an active role in live client processes, participating in client meetings and maintaining relationships. You'll also mentor analysts, graduates and junior team members, helping develop their financial analysis skills and understanding of the real estate market.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

**Execution Leadership:** Ensure quality and timeliness of all client\-facing materials and transaction documentation while coordinating multiple workstreams, anticipating execution obstacles, and demonstrating ownership of transaction outcomes.
  
  

**Transaction Management:** Manage complex transactions including joint ventures, corporate M\&A, portfolio and asset sales, maintaining clear communication between multiple stakeholders while managing competing priorities across simultaneous transactions.
  
  

**Sector Specialisation Development:** Build depth of market intelligence within preferred asset classes or product types, producing high\-quality sector/product\-specific technical analyses
  
  

**Client\-Facing Capability:** Present marketing materials and transaction updates with professionalism, respond effectively to technical client questions, and serve as point of contact externally.
  
  

**Financial Modelling and Analysis:** Create and interpret financial models for large portfolio sales, corporate M\&A, joint ventures, and structured equity transactions, providing strategic advice based on financial analysis and market trends with efficient turnaround times.
  
  

**Pitch Preparation and Business Development:** Support preparation and coordination of pitches for potential projects, develop creative business opportunities, and execute investor marketing strategies to grow the team pipeline.
  
  

**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** Develop connections with local teams to support investment processes, manage research team outputs, coordinate with marketing teams, and build relationships with internal specialist teams including sustainability.
  
  

**Team Leadership and Development:** Effectively supervise analyst team members on assigned deals, mentor graduates and junior team members on financial analysis and appraisal outputs, and support their professional development.
  
  

What Are We Looking For?
  
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated experience in investment banking / corporate finance with exposure to real estate, or real estate capital markets
  
Sustained excellence across execution responsibilities over 3\+ years
  
Strong financial modeling capabilities \- comfortable building and critically analyzing financial and valuation models and working with complex operating data
  
Sound understanding of financial statements and how operational metrics drive platform / property value
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Consistent leadership on transactions
  
Excellent project management and organisational abilities with proven ability to manage multiple workstreams
  
Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills with ability to manage multiple stakeholders
  
Proven track record in independent client relationship management and business development
  
Deep market knowledge including submarkets, rental trends, and recent transactions
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Proactive attitude and ability to work independently while contributing to team objectives
  
Ability to mentor and develop junior team members
  
Meticulous attention to detail
  
Expert proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
  
Willingness to travel regularly throughout Europe for client meetings and site inspections
  
Additional European languages are beneficial but not essential
  
  

What You Can Expect From Us
  
  

At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. Our Total Rewards program reflects our commitment to helping you achieve your career ambitions, recognizing your contributions, investing in your well\-being, and providing competitive benefits and pay.
  
  

**We offer:**  

Opportunities for career growth and professional development
  
Collaborative and innovative work environment
  
Competitive salary and performance\-based bonuses
  
Global exposure within a leading real estate services firm
  
  

If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Head of General Counsel
description:
**Europcar Mobility Group**

At **Europcar Mobility Group** , our purpose is to help to change the way you move. We are guided by our core values: *We are happy to help* , *We embrace change* , *We take responsibility* , *We act with respect* and *We move as one* . Our culture is built on valuing the contribution and diversity of our team where every individual is treated with dignity and respect. Acting with respect is at the heart of everything we do, and we are fully committed to creating a workplace where differences are celebrated and everyone feels empowered to contribute their unique perspectives.


**Job Description**

**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1\. Legal Strategy \& Business Partnership**

* Act as the primary trusted legal adviser to Iberian senior management and all operational departments including Finance, Operations, Fleet, Customer Service, HR, and Commercial.
* Provide proactive, risk\-calibrated legal guidance that supports business objectives while protecting the Company's interests.
* Anticipate legal risks arising from business operations, market developments, and regulatory changes; recommend and implement preventive legal frameworks.
* Support senior management in strategic decisions including business development, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
Align Iberian legal strategy with Group\-level directives while adapting to the specific legal environment of Spain and Portugal.  
* 

  

**2\. Compliance, Data Protection \& Consumer Law**

* Design, implement, and maintain a robust compliance programme for the Iberian perimeter, aligned with Group Compliance standards and applicable Spanish and Portuguese legislation.
* Manage all matters relating to GDPR / RGPD and the LOPDGDD, acting as Local DPO or coordinating with the Group DPO; handle data subject rights requests, supervisory authority interactions (AEPD / CNPD), data processing agreements, and GDPR\-related internal procedures.
* Manage consumer protection compliance across both brands, including coordination with consumer associations, OMIC, and relevant regulatory bodies in Spain and Portugal.
* Ensure compliance with sector\-specific regulations governing vehicle rental, including concession terms at airports and railway stations, ITV obligations, insurance requirements, and fleet\-related regulatory frameworks.
* Oversee the Ethics and Compliance function locally, including management of the Canal Ético (whistleblowing channel) in accordance with Group policy and Ley 2/2023\.
Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in Spain and Portugal relevant to the Group's activities; assess impact and advise accordingly.  
* 

  

**3\. Litigation \& Dispute Resolution**

* Manage all civil, criminal, administrative, and regulatory proceedings involving Europcar and Goldcar entities in the Iberian perimeter, including coordination with external law firms.
* Supervise the preparation of legal submissions and pleadings; maintain oversight of litigation strategy, timelines, and exposure assessments.
* Manage pre\-litigation disputes, including consumer complaints, insurance claims, and counterparty demands, in coordination with relevant operational areas.
Maintain an up\-to\-date litigation register; provide regular reporting on exposure, provisions, and case status to the CFO and Group General Counsel.  
* 

  

**4\. Commercial Contracts \& Public Procurement**

* Provide legal advice on all material contracts including fleet acquisition and financing agreements, concession contracts with airport operators (AENA, ANA, private operators) and railway station operators (Adif, IP), commercial agreements with travel agencies, brokers and corporates, supplier and technology contracts, and insurance policies.
* Lead or support legal aspects of tender processes and public procurement, including preparation, review, and submission of bids for airport and railway station concessions in Spain and Portugal, for both Europcar and Goldcar brands.
* Review and advise on the Company's standard terms and conditions (B2C and B2B), ensuring alignment with consumer protection legislation and sector\-specific regulations.
Advise on negotiations with counterparties; coordinate contract management with internal stakeholders to ensure legal review and sign\-off on significant commitments.  
* 

  

**5\. Corporate Governance \& Secretariat**

* Manage corporate housekeeping for Iberian legal entities, including board minutes, shareholder resolutions, powers of attorney, notarial acts, and registry filings in Spain and Portugal.
* Act as or support the Company Secretary function for relevant Iberian entities.
Ensure proper maintenance of corporate records and statutory registers; liaise with notaries, the Registro Mercantil, and public registries as required.  
* 

  

**6\. Team Leadership \& External Counsel Management**

* Lead, develop, and support one Legal Specialist Iberia, ensuring effective coverage of day\-to\-day legal needs and appropriate prioritisation of workload.
* Select, instruct, and manage external law firms for specialist matters (litigation, employment, regulatory, real estate, etc.), ensuring quality, cost\-efficiency, and alignment with legal strategy.
* Foster legal awareness across the business; deliver training and guidance to internal stakeholders on relevant legal topics.
Specific focus on expertise and experience in the management of external law firms in Portugal  
* 

  

**7\. Group Interface \& International Coordination**

* Serve as the primary legal contact between the Iberian business and the Group General Counsel's office; ensure timely reporting and escalation of material legal matters.
* Implement Group legal policies and guidelines within the Iberian perimeter, including in the areas of data protection, competition law, anti\-corruption, and contract standards.
* Cooperate with legal counterparts in other Group jurisdictions on cross\-border matters and shared projects.
Support the adaptation of Group\-level legal frameworks and governance standards into Iberian operations as corporate integration progresses.  
* 

  

**REQUIRED PROFILE**

**Academic Qualifications**

* Law degree required.
* Master's degree in Business Law, EU Law, or an MBA — strongly preferred.
* Bar admission (Colegio de Abogados) — required.
Additional qualifications in Data Protection (CIPP/E, CIPM or equivalent) or Compliance (ICA, CAMS or equivalent) — valued.  
* 

  

**Professional Experience**

* Minimum 10\-15 years of legal experience, combining private practice (leading law firm) and/or in\-house roles in a complex, multi\-jurisdictional business environment.
* Demonstrated expertise in at least three of the following: commercial contracts and public procurement / concessions; GDPR and consumer law; regulatory compliance and ethics; corporate governance; dispute resolution and litigation management; fleet, mobility, logistics, or transport\-sector legal work.
* Track record of managing external counsel, controlling legal spend, and reporting to senior management on legal risk.
* Prior experience as a Head of Legal or equivalent senior in\-house role in an international company — highly valued.
* Experience in the vehicle rental, mobility, travel, hospitality, or regulated consumer services sectors — a strong plus.
Familiarity with public tender processes and airport or railway concession frameworks in Spain and/or Portugal — a strong plus.  
* 

  

**Technical \& Legal Knowledge**

* Deep knowledge of Spanish and Portuguese commercial, corporate, and contract law.
* Strong command of GDPR / RGPD and the LOPDGDD, including current AEPD / CNPD enforcement practice.
* Solid understanding of consumer protection law in Spain and Portugal, including sector\-specific regulations applicable to vehicle rental.
* Working knowledge of Spanish public procurement law (Ley 9/2017 LCSP) and concession frameworks applicable to transport infrastructure.
* Familiarity with criminal compliance frameworks (Art. 31bis Codigo Penal) and whistleblowing legislation (Ley 2/2023\).
Proficiency with legal databases (Westlaw, Aranzadi, etc.) and standard legal management tools.  
* 

  

**Languages**

* Spanish — native or full professional proficiency (C2\).
* English — full professional proficiency (C1 minimum); primary language for Group\-level communication and documentation.
Portuguese — professional working proficiency strongly valued, given direct responsibility for Portuguese operations.  
* 

  

**Competencies \& Personal Attributes**

* Strategic thinker with strong commercial acumen; provides pragmatic, business\-oriented advice beyond purely technical legal analysis.
* High degree of autonomy and personal accountability; able to lead the legal function with limited resources and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; credible with senior management, Group functions, and external parties.
* Strong leadership and people management skills; committed to developing the team and building legal awareness across the organisation.
* Resilient, solutions\-focused, and comfortable operating in an environment of organisational change and complexity.
* Highest standards of professional ethics, integrity, and confidentiality.
Ability to identify, quantify, and communicate legal and regulatory risk clearly to non\-legal audiences, including C\-level stakeholders and Group governance bodies.  
* 

  

We welcome and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender reassignment, nationality, sexual orientation, age, disability status, religion, or any other dimension of diversity. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the communities we serve and fostering an environment of equity and inclusion, where respect for one another is essential. WHO WE ARE
  
  

**At Avolta (SIX:** AVOL), our people are at the driving force behind our success. With a team of over 76,000 individuals representing more than 150 nationalities, we are a truly global company driven by passion, innovation, and excellence.
  
  

Avolta is the leading global travel retail and food \& beverage player, placing the traveler at the heart of everything we do. By combining travel retail, convenience and F\&B, we create integrated and innovative experiences across the traveler’s journey.
  
  

Our 77,000 team members deliver these experiences every day across more than 5,100 outlets in around 1,000 locations, including airports, motorways and other travel destinations, in over 70 countries.
  
  

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
  
  

The Global Category Management Demand Planning Specialist supports the Produce category at a global level, driving accurate demand forecasting, sales and stock performance analysis, and effective inventory management across a luxury brands and stores. The role partners closely with Buying, Local Operations, and Finance to support seasonal Open‑to‑Buy (OTB) planning, optimize financial performance, manage stock risks, and improve forecasting accuracy through data‑driven insights and statistical modeling.
  
  

The role reports to the Global Category Management Planning \& Pricing Head and is based in Madrid, Spain.
  
  

RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  

Build and maintain sales and demand forecasts by brand, category, and store across short\-, mid\-, and long\-term planning horizons
  
Translate sales forecasts into seasonal Open\-to\-Buy (OTB), stock targets, and replenishment plans
  
Produce and analyze financial KPI reports covering sales, margin, stock positions, weeks of supply (WOS), service levels, ageing stock, and forecast accuracy
  
Generate dashboards and management reports to support weekly trade meetings, monthly reviews, and effective decision\-making
  
Partner with Buyers, Retail teams, Local Operations, and Finance to plan new launches, special projects, seasonal demand, and store openings
  
Monitor terminal, slow\-moving, ageing, and obsolete stock positions, proactively highlighting risks and opportunities
  
Recommend and support proactive stock actions, including replenishments, transfers, returns to vendor (RTVs), markdown proposals, liquidation programs, and outlet clearance plans
  
Propose cost initiatives and support provision accruals related to stock obsolescence, ensuring clearance targets are aligned with financial expectations
  
Manage Never\-Out\-of\-Stock (NOS) replenishment and support day\-to\-day demand control using statistical forecast models
  
Continuously improve demand planning models, dashboards, and stock management processes by leveraging historical trends, seasonality, and client behavior
  
  

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
  
  

1\-2 years of experience in demand planning, merchandising planning, inventory planning, supply chain planning, or a similar analytical role
  
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support business decision\-making
  
Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI or other reporting tools is considered an advantage
  
Exposure to forecasting, inventory management, replenishment, or retail planning processes is desirable
  
Experience with planning systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Anaplan, or similar tools) is a plus
  
Detail\-oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working with large datasets
  
Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to different stakeholders
  
Collaborative, proactive, and eager to learn and develop within a fast\-paced retail environment
  
Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset

We look forward to connecting with you soon!

title: Marketing Operations Manager / Lead Journey
description:
**Marketing Operations Manager / Lead Journey – Demand Generation CoE**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------


### **Role Summary**


The Marketing Operations Manager / Lead Journey sits within the **Demand Generation Center of Excellence (CoE) reporting to the Director of Customer Engagement, and owns the design, execution, and optimization of end\-to\-end lead journeys from anonymous engagement through MQL** across multiple global brands and regions.


This role owns the lead journey **from anonymous engagement through MQL handoff to Sales**, ensuring prospects are captured, identified, nurtured, scored, and qualified consistently. The Marketing Operations Manager / Lead Journey balances global standardization with regional flexibility to deliver frictionless, scalable lead journeys.


Lead flow is treated as a product: intentionally designed, governed, measured, and continuously improved.

  

### **What You’ll Be Responsible For**


* Own and optimize lead journeys from anonymous engagement through MQL across global brands
* Design and govern dark\-funnel capture, identification, nurturing, scoring, and qualification flows
* Own routing logic and lifecycle governance up to MQL handoff
* Align lead capture and engagement across web forms, chat, messaging, call\-back, and other interaction channels
* Partner with regional teams to adapt journeys to local market needs while maintaining global standards
* Monitor funnel performance through MQL; diagnose bottlenecks, leakage, and growth opportunities
* Govern lead data hygiene, taxonomy, and cross\-platform consistency
* Collaborate with analytics to improve attribution, scoring accuracy, and funnel reporting through MQL

**Who Should Apply / Desired Profile**
--------------------------------------


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys owning the **front half of the funnel** and making complexity invisible to customers and teams.


You may be a strong fit if you:


* Love designing how anonymous demand turns into qualified demand
* Think in journeys, logic, and behavioral signals
* Are deeply curious about what happens *before* a lead becomes “sales\-ready”
* Enjoy untangling messy funnels and building clean, scalable systems
* Can balance global frameworks with regional nuance and reality
* Are comfortable partnering with Sales without owning post\-MQL execution
* Value clarity, documentation, and governance as tools for speed and scale
* Influence effectively across brands, regions, and functions without direct authority

  

### **Core Skills \& Experience**


* Strong experience in demand generation operations, lead management, or marketing operations
* Hands\-on work with marketing automation platforms, lifecycle orchestration, and lead scoring
* Solid understanding of CRM concepts and MQL definitions, handoff logic, and governance
* Experience supporting multiple brands or regions within a shared demand generation model
* Analytical mindset with the ability to diagnose funnel issues and optimize performance through MQL
* Clear communicator in global, cross\-functional environments

  

### **Nice to Have**


* Experience with Eloqua (segmentation, nurture design, forms, integrations)
* Familiarity with customer interaction or omnichannel platforms (e.g., chat, messaging, call routing), preferred hands\-on experience with Genesys.
* Understanding of Salesforce lead objects and MQL handoff models
* Exposure to journey orchestration tools, chatbots, or AI\-assisted engagement
* Experience working with analytics or data platforms to support dark\-funnel visibility and attribution

Are you ready to unlock your potential? At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact \- driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. Working as a peer to Product Management Directors, you will orchestrate complex, multidisciplinary solutions across domains such as data acquisition, surgical, restorative, manufacturing and digital platforms. title: Sr. Analyst , Global Operational Excellence
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Please note: This job is advertised for Luxembourg but can be located in any of our EU sites or offices.  

  

We are seeking a Senior Analyst to own the analytical backbone across multiple high\-impact domains within EU Inbound Supply Chain. This is not a single\-metric reporting role you will design scalable data architectures, build production\-grade analytics systems, and drive strategic decisions through data, working across both real\-time streaming and batch processing to get the team the right data at the right time.  

  

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical expertise in data engineering and analytics with the ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders and turn ambiguous business problems into measurable solutions. You're equally comfortable building scalable pipelines on AWS services over terabytes of data, architecting a real\-time monitoring solution, presenting to senior leadership, or prototyping GenAI tools to scale analytical capacity.  

  

What makes this role unique:  

\- Context\-switching is the job \- one week you're decomposing a delivery\-accuracy variance across the EU network; the next you're building a real\-time Inbound Management pipeline; the week after you're prototyping a GenAI tool that auto\-generates root\-cause narratives for business reviews.  

\- Federated stakeholder model \- you'll work across Engineering, Science, Transportation, Planning, Finance, and Operations. Aligning on definitions and building shared analytical frameworks matters as much as writing the code.  

\- GenAI as a force multiplier \- you won't just use AI tools, you'll build them: agentic deep\-dives, automated narrative generation, and intelligent alerting that scale analysis across inbound speed, DEA, and transportation optimization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and own end\-to\-end data architectures spanning real\-time streaming (Kinesis, Flink) and batch processing (EMR, Redshift, Athena), selecting the right paradigm for the latency, volume, and criticality at hand.
* Build production\-grade, scalable ETL/ELT pipelines processing multi\-TB datasets daily across Redshift, Athena, S3, and DynamoDB with data\-quality checks, monitoring, and alerting.
* Architect real\-time analytics for operational monitoring: live visibility into inbound flows, delivery accuracy, dock congestion, and network disruptions.
* Own metric frameworks and reporting: design KPIs, build automated dashboards (QuickSight), support WBR/MBR narratives, and own the “why” through root\-cause analysis when metrics move.
* Develop GenAI\-driven tooling and agentic workflows that automate reporting narratives and root\-cause analysis, reducing time\-to\-insight from days to minutes.
* Drive deep\-dive investigations across complex, multi\-source datasets tracing issues to specific products, warehouses, or routes, then quantifying network\-wide impact with statistical methods.

  

A day in the life  

You'll have exposure to the full data\-product lifecycle — from defining metrics to designing architectures, building pipelines, and delivering insights to senior leadership. A typical week might include:  

* Designing pipelines that unify real\-time event streams (shipment scans, trailer movements, inventory updates) and batch sources (forecasts, historical performance) into a single analytical layer.
* Writing advanced SQL across multiple sources to investigate why delivery promises were missed from the customer order through placement, transportation, and fulfillment.
* Building Python\-based automation for anomaly detection, statistical modeling, and reporting.
* Iterating on GenAI\-powered tools and presenting data\-driven recommendations, with clear quantification of customer and cost impact, to senior leadership.
* Triaging emerging operational issues from real\-time dashboards and providing data\-backed context.

  

About the team  

The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon’s EU fulfillment network and ROW. We work at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved, and delivered reducing costs while improving customer experience. Our team leverages large\-scale data analysis, automation, and cross\-functional collaboration to solve complex supply chain challenges across Inbound Speed, Delivery Estimate Accuracy (DEA), and network performance.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, economics, engineering, or operations research.
* Experience in analytics, data engineering, or business intelligence at a large\-scale enterprise, including data\-warehouse architecture, data modeling, and ETL/ELT pipeline design.
* Advanced SQL and programming (Python or equivalent) to extract, transform, and clean large (multi\-TB) datasets, plus scripting for pipeline automation and scheduling.
* Experience with both real\-time streaming (e.g., Kinesis, Kafka, Flink) and batch processing (e.g., EMR, Hive) systems, and with data\-visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau, or similar).
* Experience translating operational problems into analytical solutions and communicating results to senior leadership (Director/VP) with clear business\-impact quantification.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in statistics, data science, computer science, operations research, or an equivalent quantitative field.
* Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Athena, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, SageMaker, and DynamoDB.


\- Experience with GenAI/LLM integration \- building AI\-assisted analytical tools, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or agentic workflows.  

* Experience with statistical analysis and experimentation (design of experiments, causal inference, A/B testing) and ML/data\-mining pipelines.
* Knowledge of supply\-chain operations (inventory placement, network optimization, transportation, fulfillment) and Amazon internal data systems (Andes/Redshift, Cradle, Data Central, EDX).

Location
  
ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain
  
  

Description
  
  

The European Space Agency maintains a world\-leading Science Programme with missions in heliophysics, planetary science, astrophysics and fundamental physics. Its mission is to empower Europe to lead space science.
  
  

The Science Operations Department (SCI\-S) within ESA’s Directorate of Science hosts the scientists and engineers that oversee the space missions from the study phase to the end of operations. It develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, as well as archiving and curating their data during operations and beyond. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind.
  
  

You will be assigned as Science Operations Scientist, initially for the Arrakihs mission under the direct responsibility of the Science Operations Development Manager for Arrakihs in the Science Operations Development Division.
  
  

Arrakihs is a “Fast” (F\-class) mission in ESA’s Science Programme. Its primary objective is to image the halos of galaxies in our nearby Universe to unprecedented low surface brightness, providing crucial data to answer unsolved questions in cosmology and galaxy evolution. Arrakihs is targeted for launch in the early 2030s.
  
  

Duties
  
  

You will be responsible for various aspects of the definition, implementation and testing of science operations activities for the Arrakihs mission, working in close collaboration with the Project Scientist, the Archive Scientist and the Science Operations Centre (SOC) Team and interfacing with the Instrument Operations and Science Data Centre (IOSDC) Team from the Arrakihs mission consortium.
  
  

During the development phase of the mission, your tasks and responsibilities will include:
  
  

acting as an interface between the Science Operations Centre, the Payload Team, the Flight Control Team and the Instrument Operations and Science Data Centre Team for the Arrakihs mission;
  
contributing to the overall ground segment operations definition, design and implementation;
  
coordinating and supporting the definition, development and testing of processes and tools for science mission planning activities;
  
providing support to the definition and validation of the instrument’s data products, as well as to the establishment of validation criteria and the development, implementation and testing of tools for their quality assessment in coordination with the Archive Scientist, the Project Scientist and the IOSDC Team;
  
acting as a product owner in the context of an Agile development strategy for the SOC system by providing the feedback, value and user acceptance testing for the various science operations functionalities;
  
supporting the Project Scientist and Science Operations Development Manager in analysing the impact of mission baseline changes, relating to operational rules and constraints, for example, on the scientific outcome of the mission;
  
supporting validation activities and all relevant compatibility, interfaces and end\-to\-end tests in preparation for the operation phase;
  
supporting the definition, preparation and execution of activities relating to the commissioning and science performance demonstration phases;
  
supporting the SOC interaction with the astronomical community in preparation for the Arrakihs filler programme, including the coordination of inputs and provision of relevant scientific and operational information;
  
supporting outreach activities promoting the Arrakihs mission and its science.
  
  

In addition to the above duties, you are expected to continue to carry out research and actively contribute to the scientific activities of the Department.
  
  

It is expected that the position will also involve support to other survey missions in development within the Division, for example the Ariel mission, which will study the atmosphere of exoplanets through spectroscopic observations during transits and eclipses.
  
  

Technical competencies
  
Experience in defining, setting up and/or operating scientific experiments for astrophysics research either in space or ground\-based facilities
  
Experience in coordinating internal/external stakeholders on scientific projects
  
Active researcher in a relevant field to the Arrakihs mission
  
Knowledge of scientific instruments performance and calibration specification and analysis
  
Behavioural competencies
  
  

Result Orientation
  
Operational Efficiency
  
Fostering Cooperation
  
Relationship Management
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Forward Thinking
  
  

Education and professional experience
  
  

A PhD in astronomy, physics or a related subject is required for this post, together with three years of relevant professional experience.
  
  

Additional requirements
  
  

International experience, i.e., outside your home country, as well as experience in diverse functional areas relevant to ESA activities.
  
  

**The following will be considered assets for the position:**  

* Experience in science operations of space\- or ground\-based facilities;
* Experience in analysing the science performance of instruments in space\- or ground\-based facilities;
* Experience with the Agile development methodology, preferably in the role of product owner;
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language, for example Python;
* Experience with media and outreach activities.


Diversity, Equity and Inclusiveness
  
ESA is an equal opportunity employer, committed to achieving diversity within the workforce and creating an inclusive working environment. We therefore welcome applications from all qualified candidates irrespective of gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religious beliefs, age, disability or other characteristics.
  
  

At the Agency we value diversity, and we welcome people with disabilities. Whenever possible, we seek to accommodate individuals with disabilities by providing the necessary support at the workplace. The Human Resources Department can also provide assistance during the recruitment process. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via email at contact.human.resources@esa.int.
  
  

Important Information and Disclaimer
  
In principle, recruitment will be within the advertised grade band (A2\-A4\). However, if the selected candidate has less than four years of relevant professional experience following the completion of the master’s degree, the position may be filled at A1 level.
  
  

Applicants must be eligible to access information, technology, and hardware which is subject to European or US export control and sanctions regulations.
  
  

During the recruitment process, the Agency may request applicants to undergo selection tests. Additionally, successful candidates will need to undergo basic screening before appointment, which will be conducted by an external background screening service, in compliance with the European Space Agency's security procedures.
  
  

Note that ESA is in the process of transitioning to a Matrix setup, which could lead to organisational changes affecting this position.
  
  

The information published on ESA’s careers website regarding working conditions is correct at the time of publication. It is not intended to be exhaustive and may not address all questions you would have.
  
  

Nationality and Languages

description:

Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Gemeinsam wollen wir Krankheiten vorbeugen, stoppen und heilen und sicherstellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und in Zukunft. Werde Teil von Roche, wo jede Stimme zählt.
  
  

Die Position
  
  

TheData Scientist \- Enterprise Search role is responsible for contributing to the design and development of the next\-generation Enterprise Search and information retrieval architectures.
  
This role will build context\-aware, generative AI\-driven search systems optimized for agentic readiness—enabling autonomous tool orchestration, deep semantic understanding, and intelligent information retrieval at an enterprise scale.
  
The data scientist will develop advanced AI solutions, with a strong focus on Generative AI, LLM\-based applications, and scalable data services. This requires to work with large datasets, develop and evaluate machine learning models, and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to improve the accuracy, coverage, relevance, and performance of search algorithms at enterprise scale.
  
  

This role involves direct communication with project stakeholders and contributes to team best practices, while identifying optimization opportunities that enhance the impact of moderately complex data solutions within larger product architectures. You will leverage advanced technical skills to translate business needs into actionable data science initiatives.
  
  

Job Responsibilities
  
  

Generative AI, Agentic AI and LLM Optimization
  
  

* Model Development\& Experimentation: Lead exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, and performance evaluation for machine learning and AI\-enabled solutions. Design and evaluate multiple modeling approaches, establish appropriate evaluation metrics, and optimize models for scalability, reliability, and business impact.
* Experimentation and Innovation: lead experimental projects and drive innovation in enterprise search, exploring novel approaches like GraphRAG or agentic search patterns.
* Agentic AI Search: Develop and deploy intelligent agentic architectures that can interact with and enhance the enterprise search experience.
* RAG Experimentations (RAG Evaluation Framework): Design and conduct Retrieval\-Augmented Generation experiments to evaluate and improve search relevance and performance.
* LLM Model Evaluation: Evaluate the performance of Large Language Models in various enterprise search contexts, ensuring they meet business requirements and performance standards.
* Advanced Prompt Engineering: Design and optimize prompts to programmatically enhance the interaction and effectiveness of search queries and responses.


Business Problem Solving\& Decision Support
  
  

* Partner closely with business stakeholders and product teams to translate complex business challenges into analytical approaches, ML solutions, and scalable intelligence capabilities.
* Support data\-driven prioritization and strategic decision making through actionable insights, predictive models, and operational intelligence.
* Conducts A/B testing and experiments to assess the performance of search models and algorithms.
* Consultancy Provide expert consultancy on data science and machine learning best practices, guiding internal teams and stakeholders.
* PoC and knowledge sharing: Design and lead proof\-of\-value (PoV) projects, conduct knowledge\-sharing sessions, and deliver impactful demos to showcase capabilities and gather feedback.


Data Engineering\& Vector Databases
  
  

* Data Engineering\& Processing: Work with structured and unstructured data, building efficient pipelines for data ingestion, preprocessing, and feature engineering.
* Vector database experimentation: Conduct experiments with vector databases to improve the efficiency and accuracy of our search systems.
* Managing embeddings: Implement and optimize techniques for embeddings generation, indexation and retrieval to support advanced search queries and retrieval capabilities.
* Retrieval\& relevance tuning: Develop, evaluate, and tune retrieval algorithms to optimize search precision, recall, and relevance for diverse datasets.
* Data quality: Design data enhancement modules that extract, enrich, and validate document content and metadata, directly improving downstream model context, search recall, and agentic reasoning.


Model Lifecycle and integration
  
  

* Deployment, Testing, and Training of ML Models and Endpoints: Develop, deploy, and continuously refine machine learning models and endpoints to enhance search functionalities. Conduct rigorous testing and validation to ensure model accuracy and reliability.
* Development of ML Models for search: Create and deploy advanced runnable models, such as entity extraction models and metadata augmentation, to expand the capabilities of our search solutions.
* MLOps\& Monitoring: Implement best practices for model deployment, versioning, monitoring, and performance optimization.
* API\& MCP Interoperability: Interface with enterprise search engines, platforms, and other APIs to enhance our search functionalities and integrations. Familiarity with MCP and protocols for agent interoperability.


Qualifications
  
  

Education / Experience
  
  

* Master’s degree or PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related quantitative field.
* Demonstrated experience as a rising expert developing predictive models and leading specific analytical modules or project components.
* Proven track record of taking full accountability for the quality and timely delivery of analytical tasks and troubleshooting complex data issues independently.
* Experience working effectively on moderately complex data science problems and understanding how contributions fit into medium\-sized data architectures.


Technical Skills
  
  

* Shows strong proficiency in programming languages, particularly Python.
* Has proven experience as a Data Scientist, preferably with a focus on information retrieval and NLP.
* Has a solid understanding of natural language processing (NLP) techniques and tools.
* Possesses hands\-on experience with machine learning and deep learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit\-learn).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and services, particularly AWS or Microsoft Azure.
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile development practices.
* Past experience with search engines and technologies (e.g. Elasticsearch, Solr, or Lucene) and solid understanding of search algorithms, information retrieval, and relevancy tuning is a plus.
* Demonstrates excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work with large, complex datasets.
* Proven ability to translate well\-defined business questions into clear analytical problems and technical solutions.


Additional Qualifications
  
  

* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage direct communication with immediate project stakeholders.
* Ability to actively integrate feedback from technical peers and junior team members.
* Proactive mindset to identify potential optimizations or new analytical approaches within the project scope.
* Ability to work autonomously to achieve goals and deliver results, while actively collaborating with team members to meet shared team objectives.
* Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industries is a plus.


\*\*\*\*\*\*40% monthly time working from the office is required \*\*\*\*

Eine gesündere Zukunft treibt uns zur Innovation an. Mehr als 100\.000 Mitarbeiter weltweit arbeiten gemeinsam daran, wissenschaftliche Fortschritte zu erzielen und sicherzustellen, dass jeder Zugang zur Gesundheitsversorgung hat – heute und für zukünftige Generationen. title: Product Designer
description:
**About Creative Fabrica**



Creative Fabrica is a subscription platform serving millions of creators, designers, and crafters worldwide. We're built on the principle that everyone can be creative. We remove what stands in the way: expensive software, technical expertise, and time\-consuming production.



Our Studio AI suite offers more than 26 specialized AI tools that automate technical work: generate custom images, remove backgrounds, create fonts, and produce publication\-ready designs in minutes instead of hours.

Creative Fabrica Studio is where people turn ideas into real creative work.

Generators, editors, and tools live in one product: studio.creativefabrica.com. Thousands of makers use Creative Fabrica; Studio is how we turn that audience into creators who ship work every day.

As a Product Designer, you'll take ownership of the end\-to\-end design for Creative Fabrica Studio and raise the bar for usability and visual quality across the platform. You will work closely with developers and product as a hands\-on partner: independent enough to drive the design direction, collaborative enough to turn ideas into buildable UI quickly.



This is not a role for endless exploration or for lightly adapting patterns from elsewhere. We want someone who brings original product taste, ships thoughtfully and often, and uses AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar. You will have real ownership. Sometimes you will get a clear problem or flow; other times you will be expected to propose the better experience yourself and take it to a developer\-ready design.


**What you will do:**


* Lead the redesign of Studio end\-to\-end: information architecture, flows, UI, and interaction details that make the product easier and more delightful to use.
* Raise visual and interaction quality so Studio feels modern, distinctive, and worthy of an AI\-native creative product.
* Turn product goals and constraints into concrete screens, components, and prototypes that developers can implement with confidence.
* Partner daily with engineers: clarify intent, resolve edge cases early, and keep design and build in sync.
* Produce structured Figma work, clear hierarchy, components, variants, states, and specs, so handoff is efficient and unambiguous.
* Design for real creator workflows: reduce friction, improve discoverability, and make advanced AI capabilities feel simple.
* Move from concept to usable design quickly; prefer strong iterations over polishing one direction for days.
* Use AI tools to accelerate research, exploration, and production while keeping craft and judgment yourself.
* Build and evolve a coherent design system / UI language for Studio that scales across new features.
* Validate designs with lightweight methods (critiques, quick tests, usage feedback) and adjust without derailing delivery.
* Balance originality with clarity: distinctive where it matters, familiar where it helps users move fast.
* Stay current with product design, AI product UX, Figma workflows, and emerging patterns in generative\-media tools.


**What you will need:**


* 5\+ years designing digital products (UI/UX or product design), with a portfolio that shows shipped product work.
* Excellent UI craft: typography, layout, visual hierarchy, interaction design, and polish in complex product surfaces.
* Advanced Figma skills for developer handoff (components, variants, auto\-layout, clear states and specs).
* Proven ability to redesign or substantially improve a product experience with measurable usability gains.
* Proven ability to take a product or major surface from concept to polished, buildable UI quickly.
* Comfortable using AI tools in the design workflow; strong written and spoken English.
* Thrives in high\-pace environments: manages shifting priorities, ships on deadline, and stays decisive when briefs or constraints change.
* Independent and ownership driven: proposes direction, unblocks yourself, and partners with developers without heavy process.
* Original and tasteful: brings creative point of view; does not default to copy\-paste industry patterns.


**Nice to have:**


* Agency background delivering digital product, web, or app redesigns for real clients under commercial pressure.
* Experience designing AI, generative media, SaaS, or creator tools.
* Experience building or maintaining a product design system used by engineering.

  


### **Is this you?**



Get in touch! We'd love to speak to you.



You can apply by clicking the "Apply now" button.



Creative Fabrica is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
**Tiered Approach**

In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby:


* **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026\.
* **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed\-term (FTA) appointments
* **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers
* **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates

Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply.  



**Background**

UNDP is the knowledge frontier organization for sustainable development in the UN Development System and serves as the integrator for collective action to realize the 2030 Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). UNDP’s policy work carried out at HQ, Regional and Country Office levels, forms a contiguous spectrum of deep local knowledge to cutting\-edge global perspectives and advocacy.


The Bureau for Policy and Programme Support (BPPS) has the responsibility for developing all relevant policy and guidance to support the results of UNDP’s Strategic Plan. BPPS’s staff provides technical advice to Country Offices; advocates for UNDP corporate messages, represents UNDP at multi\-stakeholder fora including public\-private dialogues, government and civil society dialogues, and engages in UN inter\-agency coordination in specific thematic areas. BPPS works closely with UNDP’s Crisis Bureau (CB) to support emergency and crisis response. BPPS ensures that issues of risk are fully integrated into UNDP’s development programmes. BPPS assists UNDP and partners to achieve higher quality development results through an integrated approach that links results\-based management and performance monitoring with more effective and new ways of working. BPPS supports UNDP and partners to be more innovative, knowledge and data driven including in its programme support efforts.


UNDP’s Strategic Plan 2026–2029 positions prosperity for all as one of four strategic objectives, alongside effective governance, crisis resilience and a healthy planet. The Strategic Plan frames UNDP’s contribution around integrated development solutions that support countries to advance human development in a fast\-changing world, powered by three accelerators: digital and AI transformation, gender equality and sustainable finance. Within this framework, prosperity is understood as more than income growth. It is linked to expanded opportunities, decent jobs and livelihoods, access to productive assets, human capital, social protection, essential services, protection from shocks, and the removal of structural barriers that prevent people from participating fully in economic and social life.


Within BPPS, the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub advances UNDP’s integrated prosperity agenda by supporting countries to move from poverty to prosperity through expanded opportunities, enhanced capabilities, stronger systems, and more resilient development pathways. The Hub is organized around three mutually reinforcing pillars / service lines: 1\) Multi\-dimensional Poverty, Inequalities and Capabilities; (2\) Jobs, Growth, and Structural Transformation; and (3\) HIV, Health and Inclusion.


**Duties and Responsibilities**

Based in Madrid, the Head, Jobs, Growth and Transformation will lead the Hub’s second service line, providing senior\-level policy leadership, technical guidance and strategic positioning for UNDP’s work on jobs, livelihoods, inclusive growth and structural transformation. The Head will support the development and delivery of an integrated offer that helps countries translate economic transformation, private sector development and investment into concrete employment and livelihood outcomes.


This service line responds to increasing country demand for support on the systemic enablers of job\-rich development, including productivity growth, trade, industrial and sectoral policy, MSME competitiveness, value\-chain development, skills systems, local economic development, and transitions from informal to formal work. It will help countries identify and address barriers within labour markets and enterprise ecosystems, while supporting emerging opportunities associated with green, blue, digital and AI\-driven transitions, including jobs of the future. Across this work, particular attention will be given to women, young people, informal workers, MSMEs and groups facing structural barriers to economic participation.


The incumbent provides leadership, policy direction and strategic positioning for UNDP’s work on Jobs, Growth and Structural Transformation, and represents UNDP in the wider jobs, livelihoods and inclusive growth community of practice, including with the UN system, international financial institutions, bilateral partners, external experts, private sector actors, employers’ and workers’ organizations, and other relevant stakeholders.


The incumbent facilitates and coordinates implementation support to the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub’s second service line. The incumbent ensures that UNDP’s offer on jobs, livelihoods and structural transformation is informed by country demand, experience from the ground, and broader policy debates and analytical advances on job\-rich growth, productive transformation, MSME development, skills, informality, trade, investment, green and digital transitions, and inclusive economic opportunity. To this end, the Head provides substantive leadership in the relevant technical areas and leverages capacities across the Hub, Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs, Country Offices and the broader Global Policy Network.


UNDP adopts a portfolio approach to respond to evolving business needs and to harness synergies across interventions in pursuit of its strategic goals. This approach reflects the interconnected nature of development challenges, which require multidisciplinary teams and integrated, systemic responses. Therefore, the incumbent is expected to work across issues, units, functions, teams and projects — collaborating horizontally across the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub and with other parts of UNDP, including governance, crisis, planet, gender, digital transformation and sustainable finance — to enhance coherence, quality and impact.


Under the guidance and direct supervision of the Director, Prosperity and Wellbeing, the Head is responsible for the following duties and responsibilities:


1\) Substantive leadership and quality assurance of policy advice on jobs, growth and structural transformation:


* Provide substantive leadership in the analysis of drivers, opportunities and constraints for job\-rich, inclusive and sustainable economic transformation, with a focus on employment, livelihoods, productivity, MSME development, skills, informality, trade, investment and structural transformation.
* Lead the development of relevant, timely and innovation\-focused knowledge products, policy analysis, tools and guidance on jobs, growth and structural transformation, in close collaboration with relevant teams across BPPS and the organization.
* Ensure that UNDP’s policy advice on jobs and livelihoods is informed by country experience, high\-quality quantitative and qualitative data, economic and labour market analysis, and the latest global policy debates and evidence.
* Develop and present cutting\-edge policy options to governments and other development actors on employment\-intensive growth, productive transformation, private sector development, enterprise ecosystems, skills systems, local economic development, and green, blue, digital and AI\-related transitions.
* Lead intersectoral policy dialogue on jobs, livelihoods and inclusive growth with governments, UN system partners, international financial institutions, donors, civil society, employers’ and workers’ organizations, academia and the private sector.
* Ensure quality assurance of policy and programme outputs related to the service line, including global, regional and country\-level initiatives.

2\) Provide high\-quality, timely and responsive technical and policy advice on prosperity and sustainable finance to Country Offices in the region:


* Provide substantive, timely, high\-quality and multidisciplinary policy and programme advisory services to Regional Bureaux, Regional Hubs and Country Offices in response to country demand, including through analysis, policy options, programme design, implementation support and quality assurance.
* Advice and support countries to design integrated approaches that connect national growth strategies, private sector development, investment, trade, skills and enterprise development with concrete employment and livelihood outcomes.
* Advise on labour market diagnostics, jobs strategies, MSME competitiveness, value\-chain development, informal\-to\-formal transitions, skills development, local economic development, and employment opportunities linked to green, blue, digital and AI\-driven transitions.
* Identify new areas of engagement and opportunities for innovation, scaling and portfolio development to position UNDP as a relevant actor in line with emerging country demand.
* Leverage internal and external expertise, including from the Economist Network, Regional Hubs, specialized technical teams, UN system partners, IFIs, academia and the private sector.
* Ensure coherence and alignment of jobs\-related policy and programme support with the broader work of the Prosperity and Wellbeing Hub and other BPPS teams, including on poverty, inequalities, capabilities, health, social protection, care systems, governance, crisis, planet, gender, digital transformation and sustainable finance.

3\) Coordinate and advise on the implementation of programme and policy objectives:


* Provide coordination and substantive support for the implementation of global programmes, initiatives and workstreams related to jobs, growth and structural transformation.
* Lead or support the development of global, regional and multi\-country offers, strategies, concept notes, project documents and resource mobilization proposals in areas under the service line.
* Support global processes, strategies and action plans in line with UNDP’s integrator function and its role in advancing the SDGs.
