title: GENERAL MANAGER / MANAGING DIRECTOR — SAVVY SMART DEALS
description:
**GENERAL MANAGER / MANAGING DIRECTOR — SAVVY SMART DEALS**  

**Location:** Remote  

**Type:** Full\-Time, Senior Executive  

**Industry:** Global E\-Commerce, DTC Consumer Products, Performance Marketing

 **THE ROLE**



Savvy Smart Deals is looking for a senior ecommerce operator to run the business end to end.

  

This is not a traditional General Manager role, and it is not a fit for someone whose background is primarily corporate operations, manufacturing, retail, consulting, brand marketing or supply chain.

  

YOU MUST HAVE REAL ECOMMERCE EXPERIENCE.

  

You must understand how to profitably run an online consumer business from product selection through customer acquisition, conversion, fulfillment and customer service.

 **You will own:**


* P\&L, revenue, margin and profit
* Ecommerce strategy and execution
* Product strategy and sourcing
* Online marketing and customer acquisition
* Paid media, affiliate traffic and performance marketing
* Shopify and direct\-response funnels
* Pricing, offers, bundles and upsells
* Conversion rate, AOV, CAC/CPA, ROAS and LTV
* Inventory, purchasing and forecasting
* Warehousing, fulfillment and logistics
* Customer service, refunds and chargebacks
* Budgets, analytics and forecasting
* Team performance and growth

  

You will effectively operate Savvy as the business owner and be responsible for turning products into profitable, scalable ecommerce businesses.

 **NON\-NEGOTIABLE EXPERIENCE**



Candidates must have meaningful hands\-on experience in ALL of the following areas:

 **1\. ECOMMERCE / DTC**  

* Personally operated or materially scaled an ecommerce or DTC business
* Strong understanding of Shopify, Amazon, marketplaces and/or direct\-response ecommerce
* Understand the full online customer journey from traffic through purchase, fulfillment and repeat purchase
 **2\. ONLINE MARKETING**  

* Strong practical knowledge of performance marketing
* Paid media, affiliates, publishers, media buyers or traffic partners
* Understand CPA/CAC, ROAS, RPC, CVR, AOV and LTV
* Experience improving offers, landing pages, checkout, creative, bundles, upsells and conversion
* Able to decide quickly whether to scale, change or stop an offer based on economics
 **3\. LOGISTICS \& INVENTORY**  

* Inventory planning and purchasing
* Demand forecasting
* Stockouts and excess inventory
* Supplier coordination
* Warehousing and fulfillment
* Shipping and logistics
* Working\-capital implications of inventory decisions
 **4\. CUSTOMER SERVICE**  

* Experience managing customer\-service operations in an ecommerce environment
* Understand refunds, returns, chargebacks, complaints and service levels
* Able to identify customer\-service problems that are hurting conversion, retention or profitability
* Experience building or managing processes that improve customer satisfaction while controlling cost
 **BUSINESS \& P\&L**


* Own revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, profit, budgets and forecasts
* Manage marketing spend and operating costs
* Review business performance frequently and take corrective action quickly
* Ensure every major product and channel has clear unit economics
* Manage cash and working capital with discipline

 **PRODUCTS \& SOURCING**


* Continuously identify strong new product opportunities
* Evaluate demand, competition, margin and scalability
* Work directly with suppliers and sourcing teams
* Negotiate price, MOQ, terms, production and lead times
* Understand landed COGS
* Manage product launches and seasonal planning
* Decide what to launch, scale, improve or discontinue

 **MARKETING, TRAFFIC \& OFFERS**


* Own positioning and offer strategy
* Approve pricing, bundles, discounts, upsells and recurring\-revenue opportunities
* Direct landing pages, advertorials, checkout, creative and video strategy
* Build relationships with affiliate networks, publishers, media buyers and traffic partners
* Negotiate payouts and commercial terms
* Secure profitable traffic at scale
* Expand winning offers into new channels and geographies

 **INVENTORY, FULFILLMENT \& CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE**


* Own inventory planning and purchasing decisions
* Prevent stockouts and excessive inventory
* Improve monetization of existing inventory through offers, bundles and upsells
* Coordinate suppliers, warehouses, fulfillment and logistics partners
* Ensure fulfillment problems do not interrupt sales
* Own customer\-service performance, returns, refunds and chargebacks
* Ensure service issues are identified and fixed quickly

 **PERFORMANCE \& ANALYTICS**



You must actively understand and manage:


* Revenue
* Gross margin
* Contribution margin
* Net profit
* CPA/CAC
* ROAS
* RPC
* CVR
* AOV
* Affiliate payouts
* Payment approval rates
* Refunds and chargebacks
* Inventory levels and turns
* Recurring revenue
* Customer lifetime value
* Customer\-service KPIs



Decisions must be based on economics and data, not opinion.

 **WHO WE WANT**



We want a proven owner\-type ecommerce operator, not a corporate administrator.



The ideal candidate has already run, built or materially scaled an ecommerce, DTC or direct\-response consumer\-products business and understands both sides of the business:

 **CUSTOMER ACQUISITION \+ OPERATIONS**



That means you must be comfortable moving in the same day between:


* Reviewing CPA and ROAS
* Improving an offer or funnel
* Negotiating with a supplier
* Reviewing inventory and forecasts
* Fixing a fulfillment problem
* Reviewing customer\-service issues
* Managing the P\&L

  

Strong candidates will have:


* Senior leadership experience
* Direct P\&L responsibility
* Proven ecommerce/DTC operating experience
* Strong online performance\-marketing knowledge
* Experience launching and scaling products
* Strong sourcing and supplier\-negotiation experience
* Inventory and logistics experience
* Customer\-service management experience
* Shopify/direct\-response experience
* Strong financial and analytical ability
* Strong technology and practical AI skills
* Excellent English

  

International ecommerce, Asian sourcing, Amazon, affiliate marketing, recurring revenue and payment optimization are strong advantages.

 **THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF**


* You have never run or materially scaled ecommerce
* Your experience is primarily offline retail, manufacturing or traditional corporate operations
* You know brand marketing but not performance marketing
* You cannot explain CPA, ROAS, CVR, AOV and LTV
* You have never dealt with inventory, fulfillment or logistics
* You have never managed customer\-service performance, refunds or chargebacks
* You prefer managing through meetings rather than making fast commercial decisions

 **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**



Success means building Savvy into a larger, more profitable global ecommerce business through:


* Strong new products
* Profitable online traffic
* Faster launches
* Better conversion
* Higher AOV and LTV
* Strong sourcing and margins
* Excellent inventory management
* Reliable fulfillment
* Better customer service
* Lower refunds and chargebacks
* Accurate forecasting
* Consistent testing and optimization
* Increasing revenue and profit

 **WHY JOIN**



This is an opportunity to run an entire ecommerce business, not one department.

  

You will have significant authority, direct access to ownership, strong internal resources and meaningful performance\-based upside.

  

If you have already built, operated or scaled an ecommerce business and want full responsibility for the outcome, we want to speak with you.

  

Also add these as mandatory binary screening questions. Any NO to Questions 1–4 should normally mean reject before resume review.

title: Interior Design Associate Director
description:
TGP International is looking for an experienced and highly creative Senior Associate / Associate Director to join its studio.

  

TGP International is a global hospitality consultancy based in London, Dubai, and Cairo. We partner with ambitious brands, clients, and entrepreneurs to turn their visions into successful hospitality experiences through concept development, interior design, branding and graphic design, advisory, franchising, operations, and project management. Our multidisciplinary team brings together interior designers, brand designers, strategists, advisors, chefs, and hospitality operators. This combination of creative and commercial expertise makes TGP an exciting environment for people who are passionate about food, hospitality and creating memorable guest experiences.

  

We are looking for someone who shares that passion. Someone inspired by the opportunity to create world\-class restaurants, bars, food halls, and hospitality destinations, and who understands how exceptional design can transform the guest experience.

  

While TGP is an established international consultancy, we retain a strong entrepreneurial spirit. This is a senior role within our Interior Design team, offering significant studio responsibility, client exposure, and the opportunity to contribute directly to exciting hospitality projects.  

  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

**Design Expertise**

* Deliver world class creative solutions across multiple small, medium, and large\-scale projects simultaneously, and across multiple geographies (UK, Europe, Asia and Middle East)
* Lead projects and the creative process from concept to delivery; with proven track record of strong design narrative where storytelling remains at the heart of the project throughout its development
* Lead and contribute hands\-on to concept development and design presentations, test fits, spatial planning, and 3D models, with a strong focus on guest experience and operational functionality
* Review detailed drawing packages, finishes and FF\&E specifications ensuring technical requirements and design intent are successfully co\-ordinated, including liaising effectively with clients, consultants, contractors and suppliers throughout the design and delivery process
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of design detailing, materials, finishes, fixtures and furniture, including fabrication and construction processes
* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, makers, and other industry partners

 **Project Leadership \& Management**

* Take accountability for the successful creative and commercial delivery of projects to TGP’s quality standards
* Maintain oversight and remain actively involved and hands\-on throughout the entire project process, from initial concept through to design development, documentation, and delivery
* Make informed decisions regarding project resourcing, priorities, workflows, and allocation of responsibilities across internal teams including weekly resource tracking and coordination of project scheduling
* Manage projects effectively against agreed programmes, budgets, contractual scope of services, and commercial requirements
* Identify project risks and challenges early and work proactively with leadership team to resolve them
* Provide clear and timely reporting to the leadership team on project progress, resourcing, and key issues

 **Team Development \& Management**

* Foster a collaborative and supportive environment in which knowledge and best practice are openly shared
* Lead, mentor and train junior team members to support their professional and creative development, and maximise team performance and quality design output
* Support department resource planning, forecasting, project allocation and ad\-hoc department admin
* Manage workloads and workflows across multiple concurrent projects, ensuring teams are appropriately supported
* Contribute positively to TGP’s studio culture and help maintain an environment that encourages collaboration and creativity

 **Client Engagement**

* Proactively manage existing client relationships, ensuring that opportunities for repeat work are maximised
* Present creative concepts and design thinking clearly, confidently, and persuasively to senior client stakeholders
* Actively engage with opportunities to develop new business, enhancing internal and external communications via events, forums, and publications
* Support the preparation of fee bids, RFPs, and fee negotiations on projects

 **Software Proficiency**

* Adobe Suite
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* PowerPoint
* Microsoft Office


Experience with the following would be advantageous:

* Miro
* Asana

  

The role is based in our Covent Garden studio in London, with a hybrid working model of three days per week in the studio, and two days working remotely from home.

 **Requirements** **What we are looking for:**


We are looking for an accomplished hospitality designer and creative leader who combines exceptional design ability with strong project, team, and client leadership.


The successful candidate will have:

* 10\+ years' professional experience in interior design or interior architecture, with significant experience in hospitality and F\&B environments
* An outstanding portfolio demonstrating exceptional creative quality across restaurants, food halls, bars, and other hospitality and commercial environments having worked through Riba stages 1\-6
* A proven ability to develop emotive, narrative\-driven, and design\-led concepts and experiences, across projects of varying scales and geographies
* Strong creative leadership, with the ability to take projects from initial concept and storytelling through design development and delivery, including technical and construction expertise
* The confidence and experience to operate autonomously, with minimal supervision from leadership team
* Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities, with experience developing and managing design teams
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of project programmes, budgets/value engineering, contracts, fees, and resourcing
* Excellent client\-facing, presentation, and communication skills
* A collaborative, adaptable, no\-ego approach, and a commitment to contributing positively to studio culture
* A bachelor’s degree in interior design, Interior Architecture or a related discipline from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional qualification
* The right to work in the UK

 **Benefits** **TGP International employee benefits:**

* Hybrid work arrangement: three days in the office and two days working remotely
* Company incentive scheme offering up to 5 to 10 per cent for introductions and 5 per cent for successful closures
* Remote work flexibility: one additional week per year to work remotely from your home country, which can be combined with up to two consecutive weeks of annual leave
* Structured professional development through a dedicated coaching and mentoring program
* Annual company gathering: a global team event bringing together employees from all offices
* An employee recognition program: regular recognition initiatives celebrating outstanding performance and contributions

title: Account Director - GCC
description:
#### **About Us**


For over two decades, The Boundary has been at the forefront of digital excellence. With a global team of 150\+ experts across London, New York, Dubai, and Auckland, we partner with the world's leading developers to deliver unparalleled architectural storytelling.


Founded by award\-winning architects, our work sits at the intersection of design intuition and technical mastery. From pioneering digital twin infrastructure to the seamless integration of AI and real\-time technology, we don’t just anticipate the future of the industry; we are already building it.

#### **The Opportunity**


The strongest client relationships do more than sustain great work. They create the trust, clarity and commercial confidence that allow ambitious ideas to move forward.


At The Boundary, we partner with leading developers, architects, real estate businesses and global brands to bring places and ideas to life. Our Account Directors sit at the centre of those partnerships \- understanding what matters to the client, aligning the right internal teams and ensuring that every interaction strengthens the relationship.


We are looking for an experienced Account Director to lead a portfolio of high\-value accounts across the GCC region. This is a senior client leadership role with clear accountability for relationship health, retention, account growth and service excellence.

#### **What we're looking for**


You are a strategic account leader who combines excellent judgement with strong commercial instincts. You understand how to build trusted, long\-term relationships while identifying the opportunities that create genuine value for both the client and the business.


You are comfortable working across complex, multi\-service accounts and high\-profile projects. You can move confidently between long\-range account planning, commercial discussions, delivery oversight and urgent issue resolution without losing sight of the wider relationship.


Clients trust you because you listen carefully, communicate clearly and follow through. Internal teams trust you because you translate client priorities into focused, achievable plans and advocate for the relationship without compromising delivery quality, capacity or process.


You are also an experienced people leader. You know how to mentor client\-service professionals, give useful feedback and raise standards while creating the confidence and clarity people need to perform at their best.

#### **What You'll Do**

**Lead strategic client relationships.** Act as the senior strategic lead and primary point of contact for a portfolio of key accounts, developing a detailed understanding of each client's objectives, stakeholders, priorities and long\-term opportunities.

**Build account plans that deliver growth.** Own relationship planning, support client tiering and identify well\-timed opportunities to retain, expand, cross\-sell and upsell services within existing accounts.

**Shape commercial opportunities.** Partner with Business Development and regional leadership on proposals, pitches and commercial discussions, ensuring opportunities are well scoped and aligned with client needs and business priorities.

**Provide delivery governance.** Work with Project Management, Production and Creative leaders to ensure briefs are translated into clear, achievable plans, risks are identified early and strategic deliverables remain aligned with expectations.

**Resolve issues with pace and judgement.** Take ownership of client concerns and escalations, establish clear resolution plans and maintain trust through professional, transparent communication.

**Create continuity from pitch to delivery.** Support the onboarding of high\-value projects and ensure the Client Services function is properly represented in project timelines, resourcing and creative\-development conversations.

**Develop the Client Services team.** Mentor Senior Managers and Managers across multiple accounts, contribute to onboarding and training, and provide clear feedback that strengthens commercial awareness and service quality.

**Improve how we work.** Champion consistent use of systems, SOPs and shared templates; identify process gaps; and lead post\-mortems or service audits that turn project experience into practical improvement.

**Maintain accurate account intelligence.** Track account health, engagement, feedback, opportunities and risks, ensuring information is complete, current and visible to the relevant leadership teams.

#### **What You'll Bring**

**Substantial senior client\-services experience.** Typically eight or more years in strategic account management or a comparable client leadership role, with responsibility for significant, complex accounts.

**A proven record of account growth.** Evidence of retaining and expanding key relationships, identifying commercially sound opportunities and contributing to successful proposals or pitches.

**Experience in a relevant environment.** A background in a creative, advertising, architectural, real estate, SaaS or related professional\-services business. Agency or creative\-production experience would be particularly valuable.

**Strong commercial acumen.** Confidence discussing scope, budgets, value and delivery trade\-offs, with the judgement to balance client priorities against operational and commercial realities.

**Executive\-level communication.** Excellent presentation, negotiation and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead high\-stakes conversations and build credibility with senior decision\-makers.

**Delivery understanding.** A practical knowledge of project\-delivery workflows and the ability to work effectively with Project Management, Production, Creative and Finance teams.

**People leadership.** Experience mentoring colleagues, providing performance feedback and improving capability across a client\-services team.

**A proactive, solutions\-focused approach.** You are tenacious, organised and accountable, absorb new technical and industry knowledge quickly, and respond constructively to feedback.

**Relevant education or equivalent experience.** A bachelor's degree in Management, Marketing, Real Estate or a related field is preferred, but substantial relevant experience is equally important.

title: Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
Rite is one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East, making daily nutrition enjoyable through functional gummies and drink mixes.
 



 Founded in Dubai and now operating locally in Saudi Arabia, we're building much more than a supplement brand, we're creating a wellness ecosystem powered by content, community, education, and exceptional products.
 



 Rite is currently available online and in more than 300\+ stores.
 



 We're looking for an entrepreneurial marketing leader who wants to continue building a strong brand, not simply manage and execute.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 As our Marketing \& Growth Manager, you will own the execution of Rite's marketing strategy across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
 



 You will be responsible for ensuring every customer touchpoint \- from paid advertising and social media to CRM, influencers, and content \- works together to build a premium brand while driving profitable growth.
 



 Rather than executing every task yourself, your role is to lead internal and external partners, challenge ideas, improve creative quality, and make sure every initiative contributes to business growth.
 



 You'll work closely with the founders and become one of the key leaders shaping Rite's future.
 



  





**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**Brand \& Creative Leadership** 



* Own Rite's brand positioning across all channels.
* Define the creative direction for advertising and organic content, both online and offline.
* Ensure consistency across Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, CRM, and the website.
* Challenge and improve every creative before production.
* Build a premium, recognizable wellness brand online and offline.



  





**Performance Marketing** 




 Work closely with our Media Buyer, UGC ads agency, and Creative Strategist by:
 


* Reviewing weekly performance.
* Identifying winning creative angles for the UAE and KSA markets.
* Defining testing priorities with our Creative Strategist and adapting them culturally to both countries.
* Ensuring creative production aligns with performance insights.
* Coordinating creative strategy with media buying.



  





**Content \& Social Media** 




 Own:
 


* Content calendar.
* Social strategy.
* Organic growth.
* Video production for product launches or specific campaigns.
* UGC planning.
* Community building.
* Brand storytelling.



 Coordinate with external UGC agencies and freelance creators.
 



 Manage our in\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive, who will support you with execution.
 



  





**Influencer Strategy** 




 Lead the entire influencer programme strategy by managing our Influencer \& Partnerships Manager and external agencies responsible for execution.
 



 Responsibilities include:
 


* Supporting creator sourcing.
* Supporting negotiations.
* Leading the affiliate strategy and ecosystem.
* Leading the whitelisting strategy.
* Campaign execution.
* Performance reporting.



 Build long\-term relationships with creators across the UAE and Saudi Arabia and ensure that deliverables are properly executed by your team and external agencies.
 



  





**Partnerships \& Brand Activations** 




 Lead Rite's partnership strategy to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, and community engagement.
 


* Develop co\-marketing campaigns and brand collaborations.
* Support our Brand Partnerships \& Sales Manager with brand activations, pop\-ups, sampling campaigns, and wellness events.
* Support the creation of packaging, PR boxes, and marketing collateral.
* Manage sponsorship opportunities and experiential marketing initiatives.
* Create partnerships that generate both commercial opportunities and long\-term brand equity.



  





**CRM \& Customer Retention** 




 Be the main point of contact for our CRM agency and support them with strategy and execution.
 



 Own:
 


* Email strategy.
* Customer journeys.
* Campaign calendar.
* Loyalty initiatives.
* Product launches.



  





**Agency Management** 




 Coordinate multiple external partners, including:
 


* Creative agencies.
* UGC agencies and UGC creators.
* Production companies.
* Influencer agencies.
* CRM agency.
* Freelancers, including video editors and graphic designers.



 Ensure everyone works toward the same objectives.
 



  





**Team Leadership** 




 Manage and work closely with:
 


* Creative Strategist, remote.
* In\-house Graphic Designer.
* In\-house Social Media \& Influencer Executive.
* Country Manager Saudi Arabia, based in Riyadh.



 Create a high\-performance culture focused on accountability, speed, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**We're Looking for Someone Who...** 



* Has 3–5\+ years of experience in e\-commerce, DTC, or consumer brands.
* Has extensive experience in performance marketing, offline marketing, content, social media, and influencer management.
* Understands how strong marketing drives acquisition.
* Has managed multiple agencies and cross\-functional teams.
* Has deep knowledge of UAE and Saudi consumer behaviour.
* Understands influencer marketing beyond vanity metrics.
* Thinks commercially, not just creatively.
* Is highly organised and execution\-focused.
* Is proactive, curious, and constantly looking for better ways of doing things.
* Has strong skills in the use of AI to set up efficient systems and SOPs.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**The Entrepreneurial Mindset We're Looking For** 




 We're not looking for someone who waits for instructions.
 



 We want someone who:
 


* Treats Rite as if it were their own company.
* Challenges existing ideas and proposes better ones.
* Takes ownership rather than simply completing tasks.
* Is obsessed with customer experience and business growth.
* Moves fast, learns quickly, and embraces experimentation.
* Is comfortable wearing multiple hats.
* Makes decisions using both data and intuition.
* Inspires the team through energy, curiosity, and ambition.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A unique opportunity to build one of the fastest\-growing wellness brands in the Middle East from the inside.
* High ownership and autonomy, with the ability to shape our brand, growth strategy, and partnership ecosystem alongside the founders.
* A competitive salary complemented by a performance\-based bonus.
* The chance to recruit, lead, and develop a high\-performing marketing team as the company scales.
* Exposure to multiple high\-growth markets, with a strong focus on the UAE and Saudi Arabia and future international expansion.
* A dynamic, entrepreneurial environment where ideas move quickly from concept to execution without unnecessary bureaucracy.
* Company visa, comprehensive health insurance, annual flight ticket, generous annual leave, and the tools you need to perform at your best.
* Flexible working arrangements and the opportunity to travel to Saudi Arabia for key partnerships, product launches, retail activations, and industry events.
* Unlimited access to Rite products and the opportunity to help shape the future of wellness in the region.

title: Marketplaces Brand Partner
description:
**Looking to join our team? Here’s what we’re looking for!**



Do you thrive on bringing order to complex Amazon catalogs and protecting brands from listing chaos, counterfeit sellers, and pricing violations? Are you the type of person who won't let a marketplace issue go unresolved until the right outcome is achieved, even if it takes weeks of persistence and follow\-up? Can you become the trusted marketplace expert for a brand, combining technical marketplace knowledge with strong partner relationships to drive growth and control? If this sounds like you, keep reading!

  

We believe strongly in our company values and live them out each day! We work together as **One Team** across all departments, **Choose Positivity** in everything we do, put **People First**, encourage speaking up because **You Have a Voice**, and above all else we are **Driven to Succeed**. If you can embrace these values and they align with how you work, then we’d love to chat with you!

 **Job overview**



As the Marketplaces Brand Partner, you are accountable for how an assigned partner brand — or a small portfolio of brands — shows up on Amazon, eBay, and Walmart.com. You are that brand’s main point of contact at Speedway Motors and the person here who knows its catalog best. Marketplaces runs as its own business inside Speedway Motors, owning SKU governance, content, advertising, customer support, and the fulfillment strategy and delivery performance behind every order.

  

Day to day that means working in Seller Central and Brand Registry — auditing every listing carrying the brand, mapping products to brand\-owned UPCs, merging duplicates onto one clean listing, filing takedowns against counterfeit and hijacked offers, and checking weekly for pricing violations, then notifying the sellers responsible and driving each case to closure. You will own the catalog’s single source of truth and publish a weekly scorecard read by leadership at both companies. Early on you are measured on control rather than sales; once control holds, the role turns outward to storefront and enhanced content, Buy Box ownership, and assortment growth. Scope may start with one brand and expand as the program grows.

 **Here are the specifics:**


* Serve as the named owner of the marketplace presence for an assigned brand or brands across Amazon, eBay, and Walmart.com, and as the day\-to\-day point of contact for each brand’s leadership, operations, marketing, and legal teams, escalating decisions beyond the role’s authority — authorized\-seller posture, supply termination, fulfillment model, MAP price setting, and commercial terms — to the Director, Marketplaces Business Unit.
* Maintain a complete listing audit across all three marketplaces, classifying every listing carrying an assigned brand as canonical, duplicate, hijacked, wrong\-brand, MAP\-violating, or dead.
* Own the GTIN\-to\-ASIN map and assign brand\-owned UPCs beginning with the highest\-velocity product tier, identifying fake or recycled codes and products listed under other brands’ identifiers.
* Execute Brand Registry casework end to end — merges, brand\-name and attribute corrections, removal requests, and IP, counterfeit, and listing\-correction disputes — consolidating duplicates onto a canonical listing, logging every case, and escalating those that stall.
* Own the listing source of truth — SKU, GTIN, canonical ASIN, product tier, content status, MAP price, and listing owner — and apply the agreed content standard consistently across the controlled catalog.
* Collect brand assets and build the Brand Store and A\+ Content presence for each assigned brand once its canonical listing set is stable.
* Run the weekly MAP monitoring cycle and operate the enforcement workflow within the role’s authority — detection, documentation, notice, escalation — routing supply\-termination decisions to the brand owner.
* Publish a weekly scorecard covering clean\-up progress, violations opened and closed, median time to resolution, Buy Box position, and listing health, and maintain the baselines behind those measures.
* Support sales, margin, and growth objectives once the selling phase begins, analyzing sales, conversion, traffic, Buy Box share, and inventory position to close gaps to plan, and build the case for assortment expansion.
* Serve as the intake point for brand\-funded marketing programs and co\-op dollars, handing terms and funds to the advertising team, and coordinate brand participation in deals and promotions so pricing floors are honored. Advertising strategy and spend are owned by the Marketplaces advertising team.
* Partner with fulfillment, inventory, and customer support teams on stock coverage, feed and inventory accuracy, buyer messaging, returns, and account health for assigned brands.
* Constantly work to improve processes; make suggestions for productivity improvements, and optimize employee workflow, while continuing to meet our customers’ needs.
* Maintain regular, reliable, and punctual attendance.
* Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* Seek opportunities for continuous improvement and professional growth.
* Perform other duties as assigned.
* Adapt to changing priorities and demonstrate flexibility in a dynamic work setting.
* Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and safety protocols.

  


**This posting will close when filled.**

  


**We’ll take care of you – here's how!**



We put our employees first, and care about your well\-being and personal life. From a competitive benefits package and 401k plan to growth opportunities, we have your best interest in mind, always.

  

* Comprehensive Health, Dental and Vision Insurance
* Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Unlimited PTO
* Paid Holidays
* Continuing Education Reimbursement
* Wellness Program and Healthy Living Reimbursement
* Discount on Speedway Motors Product, Rent Discount for all Speedway Properties, and Referral Bonuses
* Growth Opportunities
* Paid Parental Leave
* Flexible Schedule
* An *extremely* supportive team
* Opportunity to utilize your strengths and be creative

  


**Work Environment**



While we do offer the opportunity to work remotely, remote work opportunities can only be performed in the following states: Nebraska, Arizona, West Virginia, Florida, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Michigan, North Carolina, Texas, Wisconsin, and Wyoming.

  

* Remote\-eligible within approved U.S. states; Lincoln, Nebraska hybrid preferred but not required.
* Primarily sedentary work with extended computer, screen, and video conferencing use.
* Occasional handling of product samples and packaging, including lifting up to 25 pounds.
* Occasional travel to the Lincoln headquarters, brand partner locations, and industry events.

  


**What you’ll need to succeed in this position:**


* **Education and Experience**
	+ Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and directly relevant experience.
	+ Three or more years in marketplace selling, e\-commerce brand or category management, or channel management, including hands\-on work in Amazon Seller Central.
	+ Demonstrated catalog clean\-up experience — duplicate consolidation, brand and attribute corrections, listing removals — plus partner\-facing experience with manufacturers or brand owners.
* **What We Are Looking For in a Candidate**

title: Director, Brand & Integrated Marketing
description:
The Director of Brand \& Integrated Marketing will own MeUndies’ overall brand strategy and translate it into a cohesive marketing calendar, compelling campaigns, culturally relevant content, and consistent execution across every customer touchpoint. This leader will oversee the Brand and Social teams while owning integrated campaign planning, product\-launch briefing, content strategy, influencer and affiliate strategy, licensing marketing, and brand partnerships. This is not a role for someone who only develops high\-level strategy or manages agencies. We are looking for a hands\-on leader who can set the vision, write a strong brief, lead teams through execution, make decisions quickly, and measure what worked.
   

  

 This role will work closely with Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, Wholesale, and Licensing to ensure the entire organization is working from one clear brand and commercial calendar.
   

  

****Please note that this is a hybrid position of 4 days/week in our Los Angeles office.****
**What You'll Do**
* Brand Strategy and Positioning
* Own and evolve the MeUndies brand strategy, positioning, voice, visual identity, and cultural point of view.
* Ensure the brand remains distinctive, relevant, emotionally resonant, and consistent across DTC, retail, wholesale, and licensed products.
* Translate company and commercial priorities into clear customer\-facing narratives.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines while ensuring teams and external partners apply them consistently.
* Protect long\-term brand equity while helping the company achieve near\-term revenue goals.


 Integrated Marketing Calendar
   

  

* Own the master MeUndies marketing calendar across product launches, promotions, seasonal moments, collaborations, licensing, retail, and cultural opportunities.
* Create one source of truth connecting Brand, Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, and Wholesale.
* Lead cross\-functional planning meetings and ensure teams understand the objective, audience, message, deliverables, owners, deadlines, and success metrics for every major initiative.
* Identify calendar conflicts, missed opportunities, and resource constraints early.


 Campaigns and Product Launches
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end go\-to\-market process for major campaigns, product launches, collaborations, and licensed collections.
* Develop sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, business goals, channel needs, and a clear creative proposition.
* Ensure briefs include the audience, insight, objective, positioning, key message, deliverables, channel strategy, timing, budget, and measurement plan.
* Partner with Creative to develop concepts that are both brand\-building and commercially effective.
* Maintain launch readiness and hold cross\-functional teams accountable to deadlines and deliverables.


 Content and Social Strategy
   

  

* Own the integrated content strategy across organic social, campaigns, editorial, community, creators, partnerships, and emerging channels.
* Lead the Social team and establish clear channel roles, content pillars, publishing cadence, and platform\-specific strategies.
* Build a content engine that allows MeUndies to respond quickly to cultural moments without losing brand consistency.
* Balance polished campaign content with creator\-led, community\-driven, educational, entertaining, and conversion\-oriented content.
* Establish a disciplined testing and learning process for formats, messages, talent, and platforms.


 Influencer, Creator, and Affiliate Strategy
   

  

* Own the strategy for influencers, creators, ambassadors, affiliates, and other external brand advocates.
* Develop a clear approach to seeding, paid partnerships, long\-term creator relationships, performance affiliates, and brand ambassadors.
* Build programs that generate both culturally relevant content and measurable customer acquisition.
* Partner with Growth to define channel economics, attribution, testing budgets, and performance expectations.
* Identify creators and partners who authentically represent the MeUndies customer and brand values.


 Licensing, Collaborations, and Partnerships
   

  

* Lead the marketing strategy for entertainment licenses, collaborations, and strategic brand partnerships.
* Partner with Product, Merchandising, Creative, Legal, and licensors from concept through launch.
* Develop a balanced licensing calendar that can drive customer acquisition and revenue without overwhelming the core MeUndies brand.
* Identify new collaboration and partnership opportunities that expand cultural relevance, audience reach, and commercial potential.
* Ensure all licensed marketing meets partner requirements while still feeling unmistakably MeUndies.


 Consumer Insights and Cultural Relevance
   

  

* Build a strong understanding of the MeUndies customer through research, social listening, reviews, community feedback, competitive analysis, and performance data.
* Translate customer and cultural insights into actionable campaign, product, and content opportunities.
* Track cultural shifts, category trends, emerging platforms, and competitor activity.
* Serve as the internal voice of the customer and help teams understand what is changing in the market.


 Brand Communications and Community
   

  

* Partner with internal and external resources on PR, earned media, founder communications, events, and brand reputation.
* Develop strategies that deepen customer participation, advocacy, and community.
* Identify opportunities for experiential marketing, events, pop\-ups, and earned cultural moments.
* Help shape how MeUndies responds to sensitive cultural, customer, or reputational issues.


 Measurement and Hindsights
   

  

* Establish clear success metrics before every campaign and launch.
* Lead formal post\-launch hindsights that assess creative performance, channel performance, customer response, operational execution, and commercial results.
* Turn findings into specific changes for future campaigns instead of simply reporting results.
* Develop a brand\-health measurement framework covering awareness, consideration, sentiment, engagement, customer growth, and brand relevance.
* Partner with Growth and Finance to understand incrementality, return on marketing investment, and the relationship between brand activity and revenue.


 Leadership and Operations
   

  

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Brand and Social teams.
* Build clear workflows, decision rights, timelines, and standards for excellent execution.
* Manage relevant agencies, freelancers, creators, production partners, and brand budgets.
* Prioritize resources across competing initiatives and maintain a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.
* Present strategies, plans, results, and recommendations to senior leadership.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* MeUndies operates from one clear and reliable integrated marketing calendar.
* Every major launch begins with a strong brief, launches on time, and concludes with a useful hindsight.
* The brand has a more recognizable and culturally relevant point of view.
* Social and content become more consistent, responsive, and commercially effective.
* Influencer and affiliate programs have clear strategies, economics, and measurement.
* Licensing and collaborations support both revenue growth and long\-term brand equity.
* Cross\-functional teams have clearer priorities, ownership, and deadlines.
* Brand investment is measured with the same discipline as performance marketing.


**What You Have**
* 8–12\+ years of brand, integrated marketing, or consumer marketing experience, ideally within a modern DTC, apparel, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brand.
* Experience leading brand strategy and integrated campaigns across multiple channels.
* Demonstrated success building marketing calendars and launching products, collaborations, or licensed collections.
* Strong understanding of organic social, creators, influencers, affiliates, partnerships, and content development.
* Ability to connect brand\-building activity with commercial performance.
* Excellent briefing, storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, cultural trends, and modern customer behavior.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, budgets, and complex cross\-functional projects.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high expectations and limited bureaucracy.
* Willingness to work at both the strategic and executional levels.


**The base salary range for this full\-time position is $125,000\-$150,000\. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the base salary range provided in this posting does not include any bonus, equity, or benefits you may be eligible for.**
****WHY WORK AT MEUNDIES?****
****It's more than a job.****
 We have focused on building a team of people who emulate our core values. We look for people who stay balanced, go further, build relationships, champion differences, and are humble. At MeUndies, we continue to maintain a stellar brand by working collaboratively and encouraging growth with learning opportunities. There is no such thing as a small achievement here \- we celebrate it all!
   

  

****We look at the necessities.****
 We offer competitive salary packages, including targeted annual bonuses, generous parental leave, a 401k, fantastic health benefits, open time off, and more.
   

  

****We have an office you’ll enjoy going to.****
 We work in our office Monday \- Thursday. Friday is a remote/work\-from\-home day. We’re set up to support comfortable working \- hot desks, lounge, and casual seating areas, a Mother’s Room, an on\-site gym \& shower, and a kitchen that makes you feel like you’ve never left home. We’re dog\-friendly, so your furry coworker can join you anytime.
   

  

****We don’t forget the most important things.****
 We want MeUndies to be a place where you feel safe and comfortable, and we encourage our employees to hold us accountable for keeping it that way. We encourage open communication and a People Ops team that is ready to help. When you work at MeUndies, we take your needs as an employee (and a person) seriously. Our doors are always welcome to feedback and suggestions!
   

  

****Plus those special extra things.****
 We also know how important it is to connect with your team members outside of everyday work. We offer catered lunches every in\-office day, holiday parties, off\-sites, happy hours, and an annual retreat. You’ll also get a sweet employee discount to rebuild your underwear drawer with our top\-notch prints.

All employment decisions will be made, and all qualified applicants will be considered, without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), ethnicity, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or other legally protected characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, MeUndies will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable federal, state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.**
